title: PAID ADS SPECIALIST
description:
We are a fast-growing SEO and e-commerce company in the health and wellness space, managing multiple successful online brands. We are looking for a Paid Ads Specialist to plan, execute, and optimize high-performing digital advertising campaigns that drive traffic, leads, and revenue growth.



This role is ideal for a performance-driven marketer who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in scaling paid acquisition campaigns across multiple platforms, with strong experience in budget management, audience targeting, keyword research, ad creative testing, A/B testing, and campaign optimization. The role requires continuous monitoring of performance metrics and delivering actionable insights to improve conversion rates and cost efficiency (CPL/ROAS). Develop and execute paid advertising strategies across platforms like Google Ads, Meta 
/Instagram), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels, with a strong understanding of platform algorithms and ad compliance



Key Responsibilities:

Plan, launch, and manage paid ad campaigns across Google Ads, Meta 
/Instagram), and LinkedIn, and develop multi-platform paid strategies, including TikTok and other relevant channels.

Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitor analysis to improve campaign performance

Develop, test, and optimize ad creatives, copy, and landing page alignment

Manage advertising budgets efficiently to maximize ROI and reduce acquisition costs

Perform continuous A/B testing on ads, audiences, and campaign structures

Monitor, analyze, and report on key performance metrics (CPC, CPL, ROAS, CTR, conversions)

Identify scaling opportunities and implement data-driven optimization strategies

Collaborate with design and marketing teams to ensure high-performing creatives and messaging.

Leverage hands-on experience with platform algorithms and ad compliance to optimize campaign performance while ensuring strict adherence to advertising policies, platform guidelines, and regulatory standards.



What We’re Looking For

At least 2 years of experience in e-commerce or digital marketing is highly preferred.

Strong understanding of paid media fundamentals, including attribution, conversion tracking, and campaign optimization

Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new advertising platforms, AI tools, and evolving digital marketing systems, with a proactive approach to staying updated on and exploring emerging industry trends.

Experience using CRM, tracking tools, analytics, and reporting platforms (Google Analytics, Pixel setup, conversion tracking)

Experience with retargeting, lookalike audiences, and scaling campaigns

Knowledge of creative strategy for paid ads (hooks, angles, ad copy frameworks)

Experience using AI tools, automation platforms, reporting dashboards, or workflow software to improve marketing operations



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) improvement and consistency

Click-Through Rate (CTR) optimization across campaigns

Conversion Rate improvement from paid traffic

Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) efficiency

Campaign scaling performance without loss of ROI

Accuracy and consistency of reporting insights

Nice to Have

Experience with health & wellness or DTC e-commerce brands

Experience optimizing email revenue and customer retention funnels

Familiarity with A/B testing tools and conversion optimization strategies



Schedule

Full 8-hour graveyard shift required

Must be fully available for US hours



What We Offer

Full-time remote role

Training provided

Growth opportunity into a higher leadership role





How to Apply

Please submit a complete application that includes your resume and a thoughtful, original cover letter. In your cover letter, naturally incorporate the phrase “I love coffee” and share something about yourself that isn’t reflected in your resume. Also answer the following screening questions.





1. Describe your experience with paid advertising, particularly on TikTok Ads. What does your typical daily workflow look like when managing and optimizing e-commerce campaigns? Please include the platforms you’ve worked with (e.g., TikTok Ads, Meta Ads, Google Ads, etc.).

2. Do you have experience working with platform algorithms and ensuring ad compliance while optimizing performance? If yes, briefly provide an example.



All applications will be carefully reviewed to assess alignment with the role’s requirements. The shortlisted will receive an email invite for the next steps.

BIGGER THAN THE WORK

We treat this team like family. We want the people here to succeed in life, not just at work — we are in this for long-term relationships, not just good working ones. We are building something worth being part of, and the people who build it with us share in that success.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Maintain and update client websites in WordPress or similar — content updates, performance, and basic fixes

• SEO, AEO, and GEO — keyword research, on-page optimization, schema markup, AI search visibility, etc.

• Content — blog posts, landing pages, and social copy using Claude / ChatGPT, edited to read like a person wrote it

• Video — short-form clips and client content using Higgsfield and similar tools

• AI research and content support using MANUS LLM

• Manage content calendars and client deadlines across multiple accounts



CORE STACK (KNOW THE RANGE, WE'LL TEACH THE GAPS)

AI & Content: Claude · ChatGPT · MANUS LLM · etc. | Graphics & Slides: Canva · Nano Banana · Claude Design · Gamma · etc. | Video: Higgsfield · CapCut · etc. | Web: WordPress · Webflow · etc. | SEO: Ahrefs · Search Console · GA4 · SurferSEO · etc. | Collab: Microsoft Teams · etc.

WHO YOU ARE

• You maintain clean, fast websites and write SEO content that ranks — in the same week

• You use Claude and ChatGPT every day and know how to make AI output genuinely good

• You produce sharp graphics and presentations without needing a designer to clean up after you

• You manage your own deadlines across multiple clients without anyone chasing you

• You think about conversion and business outcomes, not just aesthetics

• B2 English minimum — C1 opens client-facing work and commission upside



HOW TO APPLY

This role starts at 5 to 10+ hours per week with a clear path to full time as the company grows. Competitive rate. Performance bonuses tied to client results and growth — not just hours logged. We share success — as the company grows, so do the people who built it.

title: Senior AI Product Builder
description:
Location: Philippines · Remote · Flexible hours | Start: June / July 2026 — 5 to 10+ hours/week, path to full time | English: B2 minimum — C1 opens US client work and commission opportunities | Leadership: Co-founded by two US automation & AI leaders — Harvard MBA (30+ yrs) · MIT PhD in AI (15+ yrs AI experience)



WHO WE ARE

We are a US software company building and servicing clients globally, with a team based in the Philippines — founded by two US automation and AI leaders: a Harvard MBA with 30+ years in consulting and technology, and an MIT PhD in AI with 15+ years of hands-on AI experience. We work with distributed teams around the world and serve small to medium-sized businesses across professional services, private equity, healthcare, real estate, manufacturing, and virtually all industry horizontals. We build proprietary AI products and we are AI-first: 80%+ of execution is done by AI — we want people who direct it, review it, and own what ships.

Examples of what we build: AI reporting systems for private equity firms · HR agents for manufacturers · sales agents for SaaS companies · chatbots and multi-tenant platforms for SMBs across healthcare, real estate, professional services, and more. The product list grows constantly — this market moves fast.



BIGGER THAN THE WORK

We treat this team like family. We want the people here to succeed in life, not just at work — we are in this for long-term relationships, not just good working ones. We are building something worth being part of, and the people who build it with us share in that success.



WHAT YOU WILL BUILD

• Full-stack AI product architecture — Python · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · pgvector · LangChain / LangGraph · RAG · etc.

• MCP servers, OpenAI / Claude API integrations, ERP / CRM / HRIS connectors, and more

• Set up and manage full development environments — local, staging, and production

• Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure on Azure or AWS — including security, IAM, secrets management, networking, and monitoring

• Clean specs and handoffs so distributed teams execute smoothly across time zones

• Mentor the junior builder — lead without slowing things down



CORE STACK (70–80% = LET'S TALK)

Python · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · pgvector · LangChain / LangGraph · RAG · MCP · OpenAI / Claude APIs · Cursor · Claude Code · Codex · Git / GitHub · Docker · Azure / AWS (deploy, IAM, security, monitoring) · Lovable · Bolt.new · v0 · Figma · etc.

This space moves fast. The tools we use today may not be the ones we use tomorrow — adaptability matters more than any specific tool.

WHO YOU ARE

• You have shipped LLM-powered products to real users — demos count, client work is better

• You can take a product from local dev to a secure, production cloud deployment end to end

• You architect clearly, write specs others can execute, and own what goes out

• You are curious, accountable, and care about outcomes over output

• B2 English or better — C1 opens US client relationships and commission upside



HOW TO APPLY

This role starts at 5 to 10+ hours per week with a clear path to full time as the company grows. Competitive rate. Performance bonuses tied to results, not just hours. We share success — as the company grows, so do the opportunities for the people who built it, including meaningful upside as we scale.

Send your CV and something you built — GitHub, live product, or a short demo. We read every application, but we only move forward with people who pay attention to the details: include the word SP33D in your subject line. If you are a strong fit, we will reach out to schedule a 30-minute video call with the founder.

title: eCommerce and Admin Assistant
description:
Ecommerce Product Content and PIM Assistant

USUALLY 10–15 HOURS PER WEEK, DEPENDING ON WORKLOAD



About the role

Majority Audio is a UK consumer electronics business selling audio products through major retailers and online channels. We’re looking for an experienced, detail-focused assistant to help keep our product catalogue accurate and improve how our products are presented across retailer websites.

This role combines product content writing, catalogue administration and retailer follow-up. It suits someone who can write clear English copy, work carefully with product data and keep requests moving without needing close supervision.



What you’ll do



Retailer product pages and awards

• Review our product listings on major retailer websites and record where product awards and approvals are shown, including Which? awards and Dolby certification.

• Identify retailer content fields, image areas or other approved ways to display these items.

• Prepare and submit requests to retailers to add approved awards or approvals to product pages.

• Where a retailer has no dedicated field, check its requirements for infographic-style content and upload approved artwork where permitted.

• Track each request through to implementation, recording the product, retailer, date submitted, response and live page link.

• Use only supplied, approved award wording and artwork. Raise questions before making a claim or changing an asset.

PIM and product-data requests

• Monitor a dedicated
 address for product-data change requests from the team.

• Check that requests are clear and supported by the supplied source information, then update the PIM and record what changed.

• Ask for clarification where instructions conflict, information is missing or a requested claim cannot be verified.

• Keep product records accurate across SKUs and variants, with careful checks on specifications, names and product identifiers.



Monitor and Administer a sales inbox

• Check for incoming sales orders, and ensure they conform to our standards (minimum quantities etc) 

• Acknowledge receipt of orders in a timely and professional way 

• Answer basic questions about orders with the help of our standard policies. 

• Adhere to an SLA based around UK working hours (Mon-Fri
). You will not be required to work these hours, but you must be able to meet the target time limits. 



New product and retailer set-ups

• Populate product set-up sheets and retailer forms using the current PIM data.

• Check each completed sheet against the source record before returning it.

• Leave unsupported fields blank or flag them for review rather than guessing.



Product copy

• Write, edit and proofread concise product descriptions, feature bullets and other catalogue copy.

• Make the copy clear and persuasive while keeping every product claim supported by approved product information.

• Follow the requested language, tone, character limits and field requirements for each retailer.



What good work looks like

• Product information and copy are accurate, consistent and ready to use with minimal correction.

• Retailer requests are logged and followed through, with clear records of what is live and what is still outstanding.

• Set-up sheets are complete wherever the source data allows, with gaps clearly identified.

• You communicate promptly, flag blockers early and ask when instructions or source information are unclear.



What we’re looking for

• Excellent written English and confident spoken English.

• Demonstrated experience writing or editing ecommerce product copy.

• Experience maintaining a product catalogue, PIM, ecommerce platform or retailer product listings.

• Strong attention to detail when working with product specifications, SKUs and spreadsheets.

• Good organisation and follow-through across several requests at different stages.

• Confidence using Excel or Google Sheets, online portals and shared documents.

• Good judgement: you check the source, protect accuracy and raise uncertainties instead of filling gaps with assumptions.



Experience with Plytix or another PIM, retailer portals, consumer electronics or product set-up forms is an advantage.

Hours and working arrangement



The workload will usually be around 10–15 hours in an active week, but hours will vary with the volume of product and retailer work and are not guaranteed to be the same every week.



Work will be completed flexibly around agreed deadlines. You must be available for a video interview at a mutually agreed time. Any regular meeting times or required UK-hours overlap will be agreed in advance.





How to apply

Start your application with CATALOGUE VA so we know you have read the full post.



Please write your application in English and include:

1. A brief summary of your relevant product-content, PIM or catalogue experience.

2. Links to two examples of product copy or catalogue work you have completed. You may redact client or company details if needed.

3. The tools or platforms you have used to manage product data and retailer listings.

4. How you check a product claim before publishing it.

5. Your usual availability and confirmation that the hourly rate and variable weekly hours work for you.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video call to discuss their experience and assess spoken English. The next stage will be a short, paid work sample based on product information we provide.

title: Instagram Content Editor & Paid Ads Specialist | UAE-Based Preferred
description:
Instagram Content Editor & Paid Ads Specialist (Remote)



Location: Remote · Must overlap with Abu Dhabi hours (GST / UTC+4)  

Type: Ongoing, part-time with potential to grow into full-time  

Budget: From $500/month, depending on experience and scope



## About the Role



We are a children's sports academy in Abu Dhabi with several locations. Our Instagram account is already established and active — we are not starting from zero, and we are not asking you to rebuild anything.



We film in-house. Our team shoots at the gym every week, so you will always have fresh footage to work with. You do not need to be based in Abu Dhabi.



We need someone who can turn that footage into content that attracts parents and generates bookings.



**Two priorities. Everything else is secondary.**



### 1. Editing



You take raw class footage and turn it into Reels that capture attention and keep people watching until the end. This is the single most important skill in this role. If your editing is strong, we can work around the rest.



### 2. Paid Ads and Lead Generation



You run Meta ads that generate bookings for our free trial lessons, and you can show us what a lead costs.



## Important: Our Audience Is Adults



Our content features children, but our audience is their parents.



That distinction influences everything — pacing, music, text, tone, what you cut, and what you keep. We are looking for someone who understands how to create content for adults making decisions about their children, not content that looks like it was made for kids.



If you have created content for parents or families before, please mention it in your application.



## What You Will Do



- Edit Reels using raw footage we provide.

- Plan and publish a consistent flow of posts, Stories, and Reels. Our account should never go quiet.

- Follow our existing brand book and visual guidelines.

- Create simple Canva graphics for schedules, announcements, competition results, coach profiles, and other updates.

- Set up, manage, and optimise Meta ads focused on generating trial lesson bookings.

- Provide weekly reports covering published content, performance, ad spend, cost per lead, and upcoming plans.



**Platforms:** Instagram and
 are the priorities. TikTok is secondary. YouTube is not in scope for now.



## What Success Looks Like



- Content is delivered on time every week, without repeated follow-ups.

- Reels hold viewers' attention and generate saves, not just views.

- Paid ads generate relevant leads and trial lesson bookings.

- Cost per booked trial lesson improves over time.

- Our account grows its real, relevant audience in Abu Dhabi.



Specific targets will be agreed upon during the first month.



## Requirements



### Essential



- Strong short-form video editing skills. You must show Reels you personally edited, not just work produced by your team.

- Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, including real advertising budgets and measurable results.

- Strong written English for parent-facing captions and communication.

- Reliable weekly availability and a clear response time during Abu Dhabi hours.



### Desirable



- Canva design skills.

- Experience with lead generation or working alongside a sales team.

- Experience with children's sports, gymnastics, dance, education, or family-focused brands.

- Arabic language skills.



## One Thing We Ask You to Be Honest About



We understand that good specialists manage several accounts. That is normal, and we are fine with it.



What we are not fine with is being the account that gets done last.



Please tell us how many accounts you currently manage and how you organise your workload to protect deadlines. A clear, realistic answer counts in your favour.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. **One Reel you personally edited** and a brief explanation of why you think it worked.

2. **Two or three accounts you currently manage or have worked on**, with links and a description of your specific responsibilities for each.

3. **One paid campaign you personally managed**, including the budget, results, and cost per lead.

4. **Your toolkit and workflow:** What tools do you use for editing and design? Briefly explain how you work from raw footage to a published Reel.

5. **Your current workload and availability:** How many accounts do you manage, and how many hours per week can you commit to this role?

6. **Your rate:** Your monthly rate and what is included.



## Test Task



Shortlisted candidates will receive a folder containing our actual footage and a short creative brief.



You will be asked to create:

- One Instagram Reel.

- One set of Instagram Stories.



**Applications without at least one Reel personally edited by the applicant will not be reviewed.**

description:
SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR — ECOMMERCE META ADS

Remote | Full-time | $900–$1,500 USD depending on experience



ABOUT MHI MEDIA



MHI Media is a performance marketing agency helping ambitious e-commerce and DTC brands grow. We create and test the ads that drive sales for brands operating at serious scale.



Our creative team is made up of editors, designers, strategists and pod leads working together across a large portfolio of brands. We produce a high volume of creative, learn from performance data and improve quickly — so this is a great environment for someone who wants to become genuinely excellent at advertising, not just make videos that look nice.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-quality Video Editor who understands that a paid social ad has one job: earn attention, communicate the idea clearly and move the viewer towards action.



You will edit e-commerce video ads for Meta from briefs, scripts, references and raw assets. You will work closely with creative strategists and pod leads, submit work for internal QA, respond to feedback and keep improving your output over time.



This role is not for someone who needs to be chased through every step. We want an editor who can understand a brief, make strong creative decisions, check their own work and deliver reliably.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Edit e-commerce video ads for Meta, generally using UGC, product footage, stock, screen recordings, founder content, AI-generated assets and b-roll

- Build strong opening hooks and produce thoughtful variations from winning creative

- Create clear, well-paced edits with effective captions, text overlays, sound design, music and light motion graphics

- Follow the brief and reference closely while adapting the edit to the product, audience and brand

- Make sure visuals, voiceover, captions, claims, offers, product details and brand assets all match the brief

- Submit organised work through our production workflow and meet agreed deadlines

- Apply QA feedback accurately rather than repeating the same mistakes

- Repurpose winning concepts into new hooks, edits, lengths, placements and aspect ratios

- Communicate early when a brief, asset or deadline is unclear or blocked

- Study performance feedback and use it to make future creative stronger



WHAT GREAT PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE



- Your first version is already clean, considered and close to the brief

- You understand why a hook, cut, pause, caption or visual is being used — not just how to add it

- You catch spelling, pacing, safe-zone, branding, continuity and audio issues before submitting

- You can take direct feedback without becoming defensive and implement it properly

- You are reliable: deadlines are met, blockers are raised early and tasks do not disappear

- Your work gets better as you learn what performs for different audiences and brands

- Strategists and pod leads trust you with increasingly important work



WHO WE WANT



We want operators, not talkers.



You will probably do well here if you are:



- Performance-minded: interested in what makes people stop, watch and buy

- Detail-obsessed: you notice the one typo, wrong product, weak cut or incorrect logo before anyone else does

- A strong brief reader: you follow direction precisely and ask questions when something is unclear

- Coachable: you actively want detailed feedback and use it to improve

- Proactive: you look for the next useful action instead of waiting to be chased

- Fast but not careless: you can work at volume without lowering your standards

- Commercially curious: you want to understand the customer, offer, audience and creative strategy behind the edit

- A clear communicator: you can explain your decisions and flag problems early

- Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team and shared deadlines



This probably will not be the right role for you if you only want to make cinematic edits, dislike performance-driven work, ignore briefs, take feedback personally or need constant supervision.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of professional video editing experience

- A portfolio showing e-commerce, direct-response, paid social, UGC or comparable advertising work

- Strong skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut or a similar professional editing tool

- Working knowledge of motion graphics, captions, sound design, music and basic colour correction

- Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, retention and vertical video formats

- Professional written and spoken English

- Reliable computer, internet connection and availability for full-time remote work

- Ability to work within a structured workflow and meet deadlines consistently



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience editing Meta ads for DTC or e-commerce brands

- Experience working from performance data or iterating ads based on results

- After Effects, Photoshop, Figma or graphic-design ability

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, ElevenLabs, Runway, Descript or similar

- Familiarity with Airtable, 
, Slack or comparable production tools

- Experience creating multiple hooks or variations from one core concept



WHAT WE OFFER



- Fully remote, long-term work with a growing international team

- Monthly compensation in USD, with the range based on experience and demonstrated ability

- Exposure to real e-commerce brands and creative that runs in live ad accounts

- The chance to see what actually performs, rather than editing in a results vacuum

- Direct, useful feedback from experienced pod leads and creative strategists

- A clear path to grow into a senior editor, specialist editor or pod-lead position

- Opportunity to work across different products, audiences and creative formats

- A structured production system, clear briefs and defined QA process

- A team that values initiative, improvement and high standards

- Paid time off and local holidays, subject to the applicable contract

description:
# Amazon Operations Manager to Own the Channel End to End - PPC, Profit and Growth for a Category-Leading Health Brand



We're a US Amazon brand selling health products - #1 in our category, with $5M+ a year in sales. Amazon is our main channel. Our team works remotely: a full-time creative designer, a freelance listing designer, a supply chain lead, an assistant, and an external PPC agency.



We're looking for an experienced Amazon Operations Manager to run our Amazon channel day to day and own its profit - PPC, pricing, listings, supply and weekly performance. You'll lead our creative designer and our supply chain lead, and report directly to our founder. Our PPC agency stays until the end of the year, then PPC comes in-house - and you run it. **This isn't an assistant or VA role** - you own the results. And you don't start from zero: our scorecard, playbooks, inventory forecasting, pricing tests and AI agents are already built. Your job is to run them well and make them better.



## 💼 What You'll Do



**Channel Performance**



- Own Amazon revenue, net margin and market share

- Run our weekly scorecard and the playbooks it triggers

- Deliver a clear weekly update to the founder with insights and next steps



**Profit**



- Grow net margin through every lever - PPC, product costs, returns, fees and pricing



**PPC**



- Run a $50K+/month PPC budget hands-on from January - campaign structure, bids, keywords, negatives, budgets

- Work with our PPC agency until then, and lead the handover



**Pricing**



- Run structured price tests with our pricing system

- Read the results and d
 the next move



**Listings & Creative**



- Direct our creative designer on main images, listing tests, video, titles and bullets

- Judge creative by results - CTR and conversion



**Supply & Team**



- Lead our supply chain lead and creative designer

- Plan stock and reorders weekly so ads and pricing match what's on hand



## 🧠 What You Bring



- You've personally managed $50K+ a month in Amazon PPC spend in one account, hands-on

- 4-6 years hands-on Amazon experience - brand or agency side - with results you can show

- You've managed at least one person day to day

- You've managed FBA stock and restock decisions with a supply person

- You like working with clear systems and playbooks - and you improve them

- You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) every day to work faster

- Comfortable with Helium 10, DataDive, Keepa, Sellerboard and Google Sheets

- You make decisions from data, not guesses

- Clear, proactive written English - you share updates before anyone has to ask



## 🎯 Bonus if you:



- Have health, medical or personal care category experience

- Have moved PPC from an agency to in-house

- Use Scale Insights or a similar PPC tool

- Have run price tests on Amazon

- Have directed a designer or creative team

- Have negotiated product costs with suppliers



## 💸 What We Offer



- $1,800-3,000/month, full-time contractor, fully remote

- Available 4:00-7:00 PM Philippine time, Monday to Friday

- Work directly with the founder - no layers of management

- A category leader - you're protecting and growing a #1 position

- Systems already built: scorecard, playbooks, forecasting, pricing tests, AI agents on Claude

- A small team to lead: a creative designer and a supply chain lead

- Long-term role with real growth opportunity

title: PYTHON / DJANGO DEVELOPER — AUTO PARTS DATA PLATFORM
description:
ABOUT THE PROJECT



AftermarketScout is a B2B platform for the US automotive aftermarket. Auto

parts shops and retailers use it to search a unified catalog of millions of

parts, check live inventory and pricing across dozens of distributors, and

push products and orders into their own stores and shop-management systems.



The backend is a Django application (Python 3.11, PostgreSQL, Redis,

Meilisearch, Docker) with roughly 30 live distributor integrations and data

pipelines that ingest, normalize, and de-duplicate millions of part records.

It is a real production system with paying customers, not a greenfield toy

project.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY WORK ON



- Building and maintaining integrations with parts distributors: REST and

  SOAP APIs, SFTP/CSV and XML feeds, EDI X12 order documents, and a few

  sites that need careful HTTP scraping with sessions, cookies, and proxies.

- Data pipelines: ingesting supplier catalogs, normalizing part numbers,

  matching parts across suppliers, cleaning up duplicates, backfilling

  images and specs.

- Vehicle fitment work (ACES/VCdb-style data) so a shop searching for their

  truck gets the right parts.

- REST API endpoints for the web frontend, plus Meilisearch index work for

  catalog search and filtering.

- Writing the one-off and scheduled Django management commands that run

  these jobs, and making them restartable and safe to re-run.

- Debugging production issues: a supplier changes their feed, a sync drifts,

  a query gets slow. You will be expected to dig in and find the cause.



REQUIREMENTS



- 3+ years of professional Python, with at least 2 years on Django.

- Strong SQL and PostgreSQL: you can read a slow query, add the right index,

  and know why a join over millions of rows is a bad idea.

- Real experience consuming third-party APIs and messy data feeds, including

  pagination, rate limits, retries, and partial failures.

- Comfortable with Git, code review, and Docker.

- You write tests for logic that matters and you check your own work before

  saying it is done.

- Able to read an existing large codebase and follow its patterns instead of

  rewriting things your own way.

- Written English good enough to explain a tricky data problem in Slack

  clearly. Most of our communication is written.

- Reliable internet and your own computer.



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Automotive, e-commerce, ERP, or marketplace/catalog data experience.

- Meilisearch, Elasticsearch, or other search engine experience.

- Playwright/Selenium or other scraping experience against sites with bot

  protection.

- EDI (X12 850/855/856/810) exposure.

- Experience working alongside AI coding tools day to day.



HOW WE WORK



- Fully remote, paid monthly.

- Core overlap: you should be reachable for at least 4 hours between

  9:00 AM and 6:00 PM Philippine time; the rest of your hours are flexible.

- Written-first: clear tickets, short async updates, one call a week if

  needed.

- I care about correctness over speed. This system touches real inventory

  and real orders, so "it ran without an error" is not the same as "it is

  right." Say when you are unsure instead of guessing.

- Long-term role. If this works out, it is ongoing work, not a one-off

  project.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send a generic application. I read every one that follows

these instructions and ignore the rest.



Start your message with the word SPARKPLUG so I know you read this post.



Then answer these four questions:



Also include:

- A link to your GitHub, GitLab, or any code you can share.

- Your years with Python and with Django.

- Your expected monthly rate in USD and your available hours per week.



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test task (around 2-3 hours, paid

regardless of outcome) on a small, isolated piece of real work.

title: Outbound Cold Calling & Appointment Setter – B2B Sales Hunter
description:
Outbound Cold Calling & Appointment Setter – B2B Sales Hunter



Full Time | Monday–Friday | 9:00am–5:00pm Perth, Western Australia Time



QPC Group is an established Australian office technology company providing Managed Print Services, printers and photocopiers, VoIP phone systems and other business technology solutions.



We are looking for an experienced B2B outbound cold caller and appointment setter.



This is a pure HUNTER role.



There are ZERO leads provided to you.



You will be responsible for researching your target market, building your own prospect lists, identifying the correct decision-makers, cold calling businesses and generating qualified appointments for our Australian Sales Team.



If your experience is primarily answering inbound calls, working supplied leads or calling warm databases, this role is not for you.



What You Will Do



You will be given the industries and target markets we want to pursue.



From there, you own the process.



You will be responsible for:



* Researching businesses within our target markets.

* Creating and maintaining your own prospecting lists.

* Using LinkedIn and other online sources to research businesses.

* Identifying the correct decision-maker within each organisation.

* Understanding which job titles to target depending on the business.

* Finding IT Managers, IT Directors, Owners, General Managers, Purchasing/Procurement Officers, Office Managers and other relevant decision-makers.

* Researching names, company details, phone numbers and other useful information before calling.

* Calling businesses completely cold.

* Asking for the decision-maker by name wherever possible, rather than simply asking reception who handles something.

* Navigating receptionists and gatekeepers professionally.

* Speaking confidently with Australian businesses.

* Starting conversations and uncovering opportunities.

* Identifying pain points and potential requirements.

* Generating qualified leads.

* Booking appointments directly for our Sales Team.

* Recording accurate prospect and call information.

* Following up prospects when appropriate.



This Is 100% Outbound Cold Calling



We want to be extremely clear about this.



We will NOT provide you with leads to call.



You need to know how to go from:



Target Market → Research → Company → Decision-Maker → Contact Details → Cold Call → Conversation → Qualified Appointment



We are looking for someone who has done this extensively before.



You need to genuinely enjoy prospecting and cold calling.



You should be comfortable hearing “no”, making another call and continuing until you find an opportunity.



We don’t want someone who waits for leads.



We want a hunter who creates them.



You Must Have



* Extensive previous B2B outbound cold-calling experience.

* Proven appointment-setting experience.

* Experience creating your own prospecting/call lists.

* Strong LinkedIn research skills.

* Ability to identify decision-makers based on job titles and company structures.

* Excellent spoken English.

* Confidence speaking with Australian business customers.

* Strong communication and questioning skills.

* Experience navigating gatekeepers.

* Ability to work independently.

* Strong research skills.

* Confidence working to activity and appointment targets.

* Resilience and persistence.



Please only apply if you have extensive experience doing this type of work.



Working Hours



This is a full-time position:



Monday to Friday

9:00am – 5:00pm Perth, Western Australia time



You must be available for the full shift.



IMPORTANT – Voice Recording Required



Because this is a telephone-based sales position, your voice recording is an essential part of your application.



Please record yourself delivering the following as though you were speaking to a real Australian business prospect:



“Hi, my name is [YOUR NAME] from QPC Group. We are an office technology company. We provide managed print services and VoIP phone systems. I’d love to know which one’s your biggest pain point in your office to see how we can help you today.”



Don’t rush through it or simply read the words.



We want to hear your natural telephone voice, confidence, energy and spoken English.



How to Apply



Your application MUST have the following subject line:



Outbound Sales Genius



Please include:



1. Your voice recording using the script above.

2. A summary of your previous B2B cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.

3. Explain how you have previously built your own prospect lists and found decision-makers.

4. Your CV/resume.

5. Your internet speeds and backup plan for power and internet outages .

6. Confirmation that you can work Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm Perth time.



Minimum Apply Points: 3



Applications using fewer than 3 Apply Points will not be considered.



If you’re an experienced outbound salesperson who knows how to research a market, find the right person, pick up the phone and create opportunities from absolutely nothing, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Senior B2B Outbound Sales & Appointment Setter – Proven Sales Hunter
description:
Senior B2B Outbound Sales & Appointment Setter – Proven Sales Hunter

Full Time | Monday–Friday | 9:00am–5:00pm Perth, Western Australia Time

Minimum 5 Years Proven B2B Outbound Sales Experience Required

QPC Group is an established Australian office technology company providing Managed Print Services, printers and photocopiers, VoIP phone systems and other business technology solutions.

We are looking for a highly experienced, senior B2B outbound salesperson and appointment setter with a proven track record of success.

This is NOT an entry-level position.

We want someone who knows how to pick up the phone, confidently speak with Australian businesses, build rapport, uncover opportunities and consistently book qualified appointments for our Australian Sales Team.

We are looking for a genuine sales professional who knows how to have a conversation, not someone who simply reads from a script.

Your Calling Structure

Your daily calling activity will consist of approximately:

• 10% – Supplied Leads: Contacting leads provided by QPC Group.

• 30% – Warm Database Calling: Working through our existing database, reconnecting with businesses and identifying new opportunities.

• 60% – Cold Calling: Calling businesses from prospect lists supplied by QPC Group, identifying the correct decision-makers and generating new business opportunities.

Prospect lists will be provided. However, you must have the research skills and experience to identify the correct people to contact.

The majority of this role involves genuine outbound cold calling. You must enjoy prospecting and be comfortable creating opportunities.

What You Will Do

• Work through supplied prospect lists, warm databases and sales leads.

• Use LinkedIn and other online tools to research businesses and identify decision-makers.

• Understand which job titles to target depending on the organisation.

• Identify IT Managers, IT Directors, Business Owners, General Managers, Procurement Officers, Office Managers and other relevant decision-makers.

• Research names, job titles, company details and contact information before calling.

• Confidently cold call Australian businesses.

• Ask for decision-makers by name wherever possible.

• Professionally navigate receptionists, personal assistants and other gatekeepers.

• Build rapport and have genuine, engaging business conversations.

• Ask intelligent questions to understand the prospect's current situation.

• Uncover pain points, frustrations, inefficiencies and potential business requirements.

• Identify genuine sales opportunities and buying signals.

• Confidently handle objections and keep conversations moving.

• Generate qualified leads and book appointments directly for our Australian Sales Team.

• Maintain accurate prospect information and call records.

• Follow up with prospects and progress opportunities.

• Consistently work towards agreed sales activity and appointment targets.

The Sales Skills & Personality We're Looking For

We need someone who is a natural communicator, confident conversationalist and experienced sales hunter.

You must know how to talk to people, build trust and turn conversations into opportunities.

You should be able to:

• Build rapport naturally: Make people comfortable speaking with you, even when you've called them completely cold.

• Hold genuine conversations: Speak naturally and confidently without sounding robotic, scripted or overly rehearsed.

• Get past gatekeepers: Know how to professionally navigate receptionists and personal assistants to reach decision-makers.

• Ask the right questions: Know how to encourage prospects to open up about their business.

• Uncover pain points: Identify frustrations, unnecessary costs, inefficiencies and problems our solutions may help resolve.

• Listen and think on your feet: Adapt your conversation based on what the prospect tells you.

• Be direct and confident: Get to the point, explain why you're calling and respect the prospect's time.

• Lead the conversation: Guide discussions towards identifying opportunities and booking appointments without being pushy.

• Handle objections: Confidently respond when someone says they're not interested, already have a supplier or are too busy.

• Recognise opportunities: Identify buying signals, contract renewals, dissatisfaction with existing suppliers and genuine business needs.

• Close for the appointment: Know when and how to confidently secure the next step.

We don't want script readers. We want salespeople who know how to talk to people.

High Call Activity & Appointment Targets

You must be experienced and comfortable with high-volume outbound calling.

We expect you to be accustomed to making 100+ calls on days when prospects are difficult to reach, but equally understand that a productive day might involve only 40 calls because you've spent more time having quality conversations with decision-makers.

We don't measure success purely by how many numbers you dial.

Your target is a minimum of 30 qualified sales appointments per month for our Australian Sales Team.

That's approximately 7–8 qualified appointments per week.

We value meaningful conversations, uncovered opportunities and genuine appointments.

We want someone who knows how to balance call volume with conversation quality and consistently deliver results.

You Must Have – Non-Negotiable Requirements

• Minimum 5 years of proven B2B outbound sales and cold-calling experience.

• A demonstrated track record of successfully booking qualified sales appointments.

• Extensive experience speaking with business owners and senior decision-makers.

• Strong LinkedIn research skills and the ability to identify the correct contacts.

• Experience working with both cold prospect lists and warm sales databases.

• Excellent spoken English, clear pronunciation and professional telephone communication.

• Confidence speaking with Australian business customers.

• Advanced rapport-building, questioning and objection-handling skills.

• Proven ability to navigate gatekeepers and reach decision-makers.

• Strong listening skills and the ability to hold natural, engaging conversations.

• Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

• A history of achieving or exceeding sales and appointment-setting targets.

• Resilience, persistence and a genuine passion for outbound sales.

Experience selling Managed Print Services, photocopiers, IT services, telecommunications or other B2B technology solutions would be highly regarded.

Please only apply if you have extensive, proven experience doing this type of work.

Working Hours

This is a full-time position:

Monday to Friday

9:00am – 5:00pm Perth, Western Australia time

You must be available for the full shift and have a reliable internet connection, suitable working environment and backup arrangements for power or internet outages.

IMPORTANT – Voice Recording Required

Because this is a telephone-based sales position, your voice recording is an essential part of your application.

Please record yourself delivering the following as though you were speaking to a real Australian business prospect:

"Hi, my name is [YOUR NAME] from QPC Group. We are an office technology company. We provide managed print services and VoIP phone systems. I'd love to know which one's your biggest pain point in your office to see how we can help you today."

Don't rush through it or simply read the words.

We want to hear your natural telephone voice, confidence, energy, spoken English and ability to sound conversational rather than scripted.

Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

How to Apply – ALL Requirements Are Mandatory

Your application MUST have the following subject line:

Outbound Sales Genius

Please include:

1. Voice Recording: Your recording using the script provided above.

2. Previous Sales Experience: A summary of your minimum 5 years of B2B outbound cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.

3. Proven Sales Results: Details of your previous sales achievements, including average outbound calls per day, qualified appointments booked per month and performance against targets.

4. LinkedIn Research Experience: Explain your experience using LinkedIn to identify decision-makers, their job titles and contact information.

5. CV/Resume: Your current CV showing your relevant employment history and previous sales positions.

6. Three Genuine, Contactable Professional References – MANDATORY: You MUST provide three references from previous sales roles, preferably direct sales managers, supervisors or employers.

For each reference, include:

o Full name

o Job title

o Company name

o Contact phone number

o
 address

o Your working relationship with that person

These must be genuine professional references who have directly supervised or managed your sales performance and are willing to speak with us.

We will contact references directly to verify your experience, sales results, appointment-setting ability, work ethic and reliability.

References that cannot be independently verified or contacted will not meet this requirement.

7. Reason for Leaving: Explain why you are looking to leave your current position, or why you left your most recent sales role.

8. Internet & Power Backup: Confirm your internet speeds and explain your backup plan for power or internet outages.

9. Working Hours Confirmation: Confirm you can work Monday–Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm Perth, Western Australia time.

Minimum Apply Points: 3

Applications using fewer than 3 Apply Points will not be considered.

Experienced Sales Professionals Only

We are looking for a senior B2B outbound salesperson who has already proven they can consistently generate qualified sales appointments.

You must be comfortable making 100+ calls when necessary, know how to turn 40 calls into a productive day through meaningful conversations and have the ability to consistently book 30 qualified appointments per month.

You must be confident, conversational, direct and capable of building rapport, navigating gatekeepers, uncovering pain points and securing appointments.

If you cannot demonstrate at least 5 years of successful B2B outbound sales experience, provide three genuine professional references and submit a voice recording, please do not apply.

If you're a proven sales hunter with the confidence, experience and results to back it up, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Piano Technical Product Specialist
description:
Position Overview 



Howard Piano Industries is seeking a Piano Technical Product Specialist who will serve as the company's in-house subject-matter expert on piano technology, piano repair, technician tools, replacement parts, supplies, and related products. 



This is a cross-functional role rather than a traditional piano service position. The specialist will use hands-on knowledge of pianos and piano technology to support four key areas of the business: customer service, product information, technical marketing content, and product development. You may not meet every requirement listed, and that’s okay. We value transparency about your experience and skills. If there’s a strong fit, we’re open to discussing how the position can be shaped around your strengths and our needs. 



Key Responsibilities 



1. Technical Customer Service 



Serve as a technical resource for customers, particularly professional piano technicians and other customers seeking guidance about products and their applications. 



Responsibilities include: 



Respond to customer questions by
 and phone. 



Provide technically accurate information about piano parts, tools, supplies, materials, and their applications. 



Help customers identify appropriate products for specific piano repair, tuning, regulation, maintenance, or restoration needs. 



Explain differences between similar products and product variants. 



Help customers understand product compatibility and intended applications when sufficient information is available. 



Translate highly technical concepts into clear, understandable explanations for customers with varying levels of experience. 



Identify recurring customer questions or points of confusion that should be addressed through improved product information, FAQs, educational content, or new products. 



Work with the broader team when customer questions involve inventory, shipping, or other nontechnical matters. 



The objective: Customers should be able to speak with someone who actually understands the work they do, rather than someone simply reading information from a product listing. 



 



2. Product Descriptions & Technical Catalog Content 



Provide technical expertise for product information throughout the company's catalog. 



Responsibilities include: 



Write and/or review technically accurate product descriptions. 



Clearly explain:  



     product purpose 



     applications 



     features and benefits 



     specifications 



     compatibility 



     differences between related products 



     appropriate users or use cases 



Develop technical bullet points, FAQs, comparison information, and supporting product content. 



Review existing descriptions for technical inaccuracies, ambiguity, or missing information. 



Help standardize terminology across product listings. 



Work with other team members responsible for catalog administration to ensure product information accurately represents how technicians actually use the product. 

 



3. Technical Content & Marketing 



Create authoritative educational and product-focused content based on real piano-industry expertise. 



This position does not need to be a professional graphic designer or video editor. Rather, the person should be comfortable producing useful technical content and performing basic editing necessary to publish it. 



Responsibilities include: 



Written content 



     Technical articles 



     How-to content 



     Product guides 



     Product comparisons 



     FAQs 



     Educational posts 



    
 content where technical knowledge is required 



     Social-media content 



     Scripts/outlines for instructional videos 



Video and visual content 



     Demonstrate tools and products. 



     Explain product applications. 



     Demonstrate relevant repair or maintenance concepts where appropriate. 



     Create educational videos aimed at piano technicians and piano owners. 



     Perform basic video editing. 



     Perform basic photo/graphic editing. 



     Help create product photos or explanatory visuals when needed. 



The goal should be technical credibility and usefulness rather than sophisticated video production. 

 



4. Product Development 



Assortment Planning 



     Evaluate the company's existing product assortment from a piano technician's perspective. 



     Identify missing tools, parts, supplies, materials, and complementary products. 



     Recommend new products based on technician needs and practical applications. 



     Identify redundant, outdated, or insufficient product options. 



     Compare alternative versions of products and recommend appropriate assortment choices. 



     Provide technical input into decisions about which variants, sizes, materials, or configurations should be stocked. 



Supplier & Product Sourcing 



     Help identify potential manufacturers and suppliers for technician tools, parts, and supplies. 



     Evaluate supplier product offerings from a technical perspective. 



     Compare proposed supplier products against existing Howard products and industry alternatives. 



     Help communicate technical product requirements to suppliers. 



     Evaluate specifications, materials, construction, dimensions, and intended application. 



     Recommend products worth sampling and testing. 



     Provide technical input during supplier discussions when specialized piano knowledge is required. 



Product Evaluation & Testing 



     Physically evaluate samples and prospective products. 



     Test products in realistic piano-technician applications when appropriate. 



     Assess usability, construction, functionality, and suitability for professional use. 



     Compare samples against existing or competing products. 



     Document findings and recommendations. 



     Identify product deficiencies or possible improvements. 



     Provide technical feedback that can be communicated to suppliers. 



     Participate in decisions about whether a product should be added to the assortment or requires further development. 



 



Required Qualifications 



Professional experience as a piano technician or equivalent substantial hands-on piano technical experience. 



Strong understanding of piano construction, maintenance, repair, tuning, regulation, and commonly used technician tools, parts, supplies, and materials. 



Ability to communicate confidently with professional piano technicians. 



Ability to explain technical subjects clearly to both professionals and nontechnical customers. 



Ability to assess the suitability and quality of technical products. 



Comfortable being photographed or appearing in instructional/product videos when necessary. 



Basic ability to edit photos/graphics and video, or the ability and willingness to learn the company's chosen tools. 



Ability to research and independently learn unfamiliar products. 



Comfortable navigating technology 



 



What Success Looks Like 



The successful person should eventually become the company's technical authority connecting the customer, the product, the supplier, and the content. 



You should see: 



Customers receiving knowledgeable technical answers. 



Product descriptions becoming more technically accurate and useful. 



More educational content that is credible to working piano technicians. 



New-product decisions informed by how technicians actually work. 



 Please submit your answers via this form

title: Healthcare VA, Benefits & Reimbursement Specialist WFH GY SHIFT
description:
osition: Healthcare Virtual Assistant, Benefits and Reimbursement Specialist

Work Arrangement: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Remote Healthcare Virtual Assistant specializing in insurance benefits verification, reimbursement processing, and medical billing support.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with healthcare providers, insurance companies, and medical billing systems. This role involves verifying patient insurance coverage, checking benefits and eligibility, monitoring claims, following up on reimbursements, and assisting with insurance-related administrative tasks.

The primary goal is to ensure accurate insurance information, timely reimbursement, and efficient communication between healthcare providers, patients, and insurance companies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Insurance Benefits Verification

Verify patient insurance eligibility and active coverage.

Confirm benefits, deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, and out-of-pocket maximums.

Check coverage limitations, exclusions, and authorization requirements.

Contact insurance companies to confirm patient benefits and coverage details.

Document verification results accurately in patient records.

Identify potential insurance coverage issues before scheduled appointments or procedures.

2. Claims and Reimbursement Management

Monitor submitted medical claims and reimbursement status.

Follow up with insurance companies regarding pending, unpaid, or denied claims.

Review Explanation of Benefits (EOB) and Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA).

Investigate reimbursement discrepancies and underpaid claims.

Assist with claim corrections, reconsiderations, and appeals.

Track outstanding reimbursements and maintain accurate follow-up records.

Coordinate with medical billing teams to resolve payment issues.

3. Prior Authorization and Insurance Coordination

Determine whether medical services require prior authorization.

Assist with submitting authorization requests and supporting documentation.

Follow up on pending authorization approvals.

Maintain accurate authorization records and expiration dates.

Coordinate with healthcare providers and insurance representatives to resolve coverage concerns.

4. Patient and Provider Communication

Respond professionally to patient questions regarding insurance benefits and reimbursement.

Explain insurance coverage, patient financial responsibility, and claim status.

Communicate with healthcare providers regarding insurance-related concerns.

Contact insurance representatives to resolve claims and payment discrepancies.

Maintain confidentiality of patient and insurance information.

5. Administrative and Reporting Tasks

Update patient insurance information in Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.

Maintain organized records of benefits verification and reimbursement activities.

Prepare daily and weekly reports on pending claims, denied claims, and reimbursement status.

Monitor outstanding insurance balances and follow-up deadlines.

Support other healthcare administrative and billing tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

At least 1–2 years of experience as a Healthcare Virtual Assistant, Insurance Verification Specialist, Medical Billing Specialist, or similar role.

Experience verifying U.S. healthcare insurance benefits and eligibility.

Knowledge of medical claims processing and reimbursement procedures.

Familiarity with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance plans.

Understanding of medical billing terminology, CPT codes, ICD-10 codes, and HCPCS codes.

Experience reviewing EOBs, ERAs, and insurance claim denials.

Familiarity with EHR/EMR systems and insurance provider portals.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Excellent attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Understanding of HIPAA regulations and patient confidentiality requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with U.S.-based healthcare providers or medical billing companies.

Familiarity with insurance portals such as Availity, UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, Cigna, and Medicare.

Experience with claims follow-up, denial management, and accounts receivable.

Knowledge of prior authorization and medical necessity requirements.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and healthcare practice management software.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be measured through:

Benefits Verification Accuracy: Target of 98% or higher.

Verification Turnaround: Complete routine insurance verification within 24 hours or before scheduled appointments.

Claims Follow-Up: Review and follow up on assigned outstanding claims within established deadlines.

Reimbursement Tracking: Maintain accurate and updated reimbursement records.

Denial Resolution: Reduce unresolved denied claims through timely follow-up and proper documentation.

Documentation Accuracy: Maintain complete and accurate records of insurance communications and claim updates.

Productivity: Meet assigned daily and weekly workload targets while maintaining quality standards.

Work Requirements

Reliable high-speed internet connection.

Quiet, professional, and private home workspace.

Computer capable of running healthcare management applications.

Availability to work during designated U.S. business hours.

Ability to handle sensitive patient information using approved, secure systems.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, highly organized, and experienced in navigating U.S. healthcare insurance processes. They can independently verify benefits, identify reimbursement issues, communicate effectively with insurance representatives, and help healthcare providers maintain consistent cash flow through accurate and timely claims management.

title: Quality Assurance Team Lead (KYC/KYB Experience)
description:
Key Responsibilities

– Build and implement the KYC/KYB QA framework, including sampling, scoring and review methodology. Design the QA framework from the ground up, a risk-weighted sampling approach (higher-risk cases reviewed more frequently than lower-risk ones), a scoring methodology that captures both document completeness and the quality of the risk judgment behind it, and a review cadence that scales as case volume grows.

– Conduct quality reviews of KYC/KYB, CDD and EDD cases, including higher-risk customers. Independently review completed onboarding files checking risk-tier accuracy, screening disposition, source of funds/wealth evidencing, and (for entity clients) whether ownership structures were properly unwrapped to identify beneficial owners. Higher-risk and EDD cases receive closer scrutiny given the greater consequence of getting them wrong.

– Identify errors, trends and root causes and recommend improvements. Go beyond flagging individual mistakes — group findings by root cause (e.g. a documentation gap vs. a genuine risk judgment error vs. a partner-specific requirement being missed) so fixes target the actual cause, whether that's a training gap, an SOP gap, or a partner requirement that isn't properly documented.

– Develop QA reporting, KPIs and management information for the Head of Compliance.

– Own a regular reporting cadence covering quality trends, recurring error types, and partner specific RFI patterns — feeding a core KPI: reducing avoidable back-and-forth with our banking partners by catching issues before submission, not after.

– Work closely with the Head of Compliance to improve processes and controls.

– Act as the operational link between the compliance policy framework and how the team actually executes day to day — flagging where documented process and real practice have drifted apart, and helping close that gap.

– Identify training needs and provide feedback to onboarding teams.

– Use QA findings to drive what training actually happens — not generic refreshers, but targeted sessions addressing the specific gaps the data is showing (e.g. a pattern of source of funds vs. source of wealth confusion, or inconsistent handling of layered ownership structures).

– Continuously improve the QA framework as the business grows.

– Evolve the framework as new banking partners, products, or entity types are added.



Qualifications

– Must have at least 3 years of QA KYC team lead experience

– Must have experience in KYC, AML, Compliance or Financial Crime QA within fintech, payments or financial services.

– Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD and risk-based onboarding.

– Direct, hands-on experience assessing KYC/KYB case quality (not general customer support QA experience). This role needs someone who can independently judge whether a compliance decision was right, not just whether a process step was followed.

– Experience building a QA framework from scratch. (This is a build role, not a maintain role. The successful candidate has built up a QA function before, not just operated within an existing one

– Strong understanding of QA methodologies, scorecard design, and performance evaluation.

– Comfortable designing scoring criteria that are consistent and defensible across reviewers, and calibrating so different reviewers reach the same conclusion on the same file.

– Genuine technical depth, able to independently assess whether a risk tier was applied correctly, whether EDD was sufficient, and whether an ownership structure was properly unwrapped, not just whether a checklist was completed.

– Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations. Able to turn QA findings into practical process improvements/training

– QA findings are only useful if they change something, this role needs to turn patterns into concrete process, training, or policy recommendations, not just produce reports.

– Confident, challenging decisions and escalating issues. This role will sometimes need to tell an experienced analyst, or flag to the Head of Compliance, that something isn't good enough.

– The end output of QA work here isn't a report that sits unread — it's a training session, an SOP update, or a process fix that actually closes the gap that was found.

– Must be comfortable using their own equipment

– Must be comfortable working Dubai hours

– Must be able to commit to working exclusively with the company and not be engaged in any part-time employment

– If you’ve read carefully the entire job description, please message us your updated CV with “QA Team Lead with KYC Experience” as the message subject

title: Full-Time AI Creative Strategist & Video Editor
description:
Full-Time AI Creative Strategist & Video Editor



Background



We’re a fast-growing social media agency producing high-performing short-form content across Instagram,
, YouTube, and more. WE’RE SCALING FAST!!



This isn't just a job. As the agency grows, the team grows with it. More clients means more volume, higher bonuses, and bigger opportunities for the people who helped build it. We believe in rewarding the people who show up, execute well, and grow with us and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of that from the ground floor.



We’re hiring a full-time AI Creative Strategist to analyze social media data from posted videos, understand content and marketing on a fundamental level, create raw AI clips, and assemble them into polished short-form videos using our internal workflows.



This is a strategy AND execution role. You’ll be taught from the ground up how to actually think like a creator - not just how to follow instructions.



If you haven't used every tool on our stack yet, that's okay. We care much more about having a hunger to learn, strong English, and your ability to improve independently. We'll give you the resources - what you do with them is up to you.



What You'll Do



Creative Strategy & Data

- Analyze the performance of posted videos and understand WHY certain content wins or loses

- Use data to create a feedback loop and continuously improve future videos

- Identify winning hooks, formats, angles, pacing, and creative patterns

- Research competitors, audiences, trends, and high-performing content

- Come to us with what you've learned, what you've changed, and where you need advice - not wait for us to tell you what to do 



Copywriting & Content

- Understand the fundamentals of hooks, storytelling, retention, persuasion, and customer psychology

- Write and improve short-form scripts based on research and performance data

- Identify weaknesses in scripts and creatives before production

- Develop new ideas and angles instead of simply recreating existing content

- Adapt content to different brands, audiences, and niches 



Video Editing

- Turn raw footage and AI-generated assets into high-retention short-form content

- Edit in CapCut with strong pacing, captions, B-roll, overlays, sound design, and visual storytelling

- Develop a strong creative eye and independently identify what needs improvement

- Maintain quality and consistency across multiple client accounts

- Apply feedback quickly and make sure the same mistakes don't keep happening 



AI Content Creation

- Generate AI images, videos, avatars, voices, and other creative assets using our tools

- Use tools such as ChatGPT, Grok, Veo3, and others as part of the creative process

- Experiment with new tools and workflows as AI technology evolves

- Quality check all AI outputs before using them in content

- Learn how to get better outputs instead of relying on us to provide every prompt or solution 



General

- Manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Communicate proactively about progress, ideas, problems, and results

- Take ownership of your work from research to final output

- Constantly look for ways to improve your own skills and the team's content

- Solve problems independently before immediately asking for help 



Requirements



Must-Haves

- EXTREMELY STRONG ENGLISH - WRITTEN, SPOKEN, AND COMPREHENSION

- GROWTH MINDSET AND GENUINE HUNGER TO LEARN!!!! 

- Experience editing short-form content - PORTFOLIO REQUIRED

- Strong WiFi connection with rare occurrences of outages

- Strong proficiency in CapCut

- Strong attention to detail and creative quality

- Able to think critically and understand WHY content performs

- Comfortable working with data and using it to improve creative decisions

- Willing to learn copywriting, marketing, AI, editing, and content strategy

- Extremely proactive - you should be coming to us with improvements, not waiting for us to find your mistakes

- Able to research and teach yourself when you don't know something

- Able to take feedback without ego and immediately apply it

- Willing to go above and beyond what is directly assigned

- Able to manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Reliable internet and dedicated workspace

- Currently working with NO OTHER CLIENTS. All work commitment should be on this role.



Nice-to-Haves

- Previous agency or content production experience

- Copywriting or direct-response marketing experience

- Experience analyzing social media performance data

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and storytelling

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Grok, Veo3, Kling, or similar tools

- Experience researching competitors, customers, and markets

- Strong understanding of internet culture and social media trends



What We Offer

- Stable, full-time remote role with consistent workload

- Access to all required AI and editing tools

- Copywriting, marketing, editing, and creative strategy resources

- Direct feedback and mentorship on your work

- Access to real performance data so you can understand what actually works

- Freedom to test ideas, experiment, and develop your own creative instincts

- Opportunity to develop skills across editing, AI, copywriting, data analysis, and strategy

- Growth opportunities as we scale

- Performance bonuses of up to 40% of monthly pay.



How to Apply



Include all of the following. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE REVIEWED:

- Start your application with the word “GROWTH”

- Portfolio or reel (Drive, Notion, or direct links)

- 2-3 of your best short-form content edits

- What AI tools have you used before?

- Short answer (3-5 sentences): If one of your videos significantly underperformed compared to the others, how would you figure out what went wrong and improve the next one?

- Short answer (3-5 sentences): Tell us about something you taught yourself without being asked. How did you learn it?

- Your timezone + working hours

No portfolio = no review.

title: Talent Acquisition Executive
description:
Job Description



Highlights:



Position Title: Junior Talent Acquisition Executive (IT Recruiter)

Company: ScalingCraft Solutions (Dubai, UAE)

Exp: 1+ years

Job Location: Remote (anywhere in the Philippines)

Job Type: Contractual (engaged as a remote contractor with ScalingCraft Solutions FZCO)

Working Hours: Overlapping with our recruitment team in India (IST, 2.5 hours behind Philippine time)

Device Policy: BYOD (your own laptop and a stable internet connection)

Role Overview



We are seeking a Junior Talent Acquisition Executive to own end-to-end hiring for our IT and digital roles across ScalingCraft and our sister agency WebIndia, including developers, data, designers, video editors and digital marketing profiles. We hire from India, the Philippines and other remote markets, so you will work with candidates across countries and time zones. This is a remote, contractual role with a BYOD policy, for a recruiter who can manage multiple open positions at the same time and close them with the right people, with minimal supervision. It is a fast-paced and challenging role, best suited to someone who takes ownership of every position they work on.



Roles and Responsibilities

Own the complete recruitment lifecycle for IT roles, from understanding the requirement to the candidate’s joining.

Work with hiring managers to understand each open position, the skills it needs and the expected closing timeline.

Write and post job openings on LinkedIn, Indeed, Wellfound, OnlineJobs.ph and Naukri, and keep every post active and relevant.

Source candidates proactively through job portals, LinkedIn searches, referrals and professional networks, building a steady pipeline for every open role.

Screen CVs and conduct screening calls to assess skills, relevant experience, availability and salary expectations.

Schedule technical interviews and practical assignments across time zones, collect feedback from the hiring team and keep candidates updated at every stage.

Manage offer discussions, close candidates and follow up until they join.

Maintain candidate records and hiring status in Zoho Recruit and recruitment trackers, and share regular status updates with the team.

Build a ready pipeline of candidates for the roles we hire for often, so new requirements can be closed faster.

Must-Have Requirements

A minimum of 1 year of hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment.

Proven experience hiring for IT profiles such as developers, data, design or creative roles.

Hands-on sourcing experience on LinkedIn, JobStreet, Indeed, OnlineJobs.ph or other job portals.

Working experience with an ATS or recruitment CRM to track candidates and hiring stages.

Good communication skills in English, spoken and written, with the confidence to speak with candidates and hiring managers every day.

Ability to handle multiple open positions at the same time and close them within timelines.

Demonstrated ability to take ownership of open positions and work independently with minimal supervision.

Willingness to work on a contractual basis, remotely, using a personal device (BYOD), during hours that overlap with our team in India.





Nice-to-Have

Knowledge of hiring for digital marketing roles such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO or performance marketing.

Hands-on experience with Zoho Recruit or Zoho CRM.

Experience hiring for a digital agency or IT services company.

Experience hiring candidates in India or for international remote teams, for example through Naukri or LinkedIn.

Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude or Perplexity for sourcing, screening questions, job posts and reporting.

An automation mindset: you look for ways to automate repetitive recruitment work such as follow-ups, interview scheduling and tracker updates.

The Finance and Administration Assistant will provide temporary bookkeeping, financial processing, and administrative support to Ethnolink Pty Ltd during the agreed reliever engagement period, with the primary objective of maintaining continuity in day-to-day finance and administrative operations.

Working in coordination with the Finance and Administration Manager, the Contractor will assist with routine financial transactions, bank and credit card reconciliations, vendor documentation, accounts administration, and general operational support.
