description:
Build a real path into B2B sales-with qualified leads, a CRM, proven scripts, structured training, call coaching, and a professional U.S. dialer already provided.



EditValue provides premium wedding-video post-production for wedding photographers and studios. We are hiring a confident English-speaking SDR to introduce our service to U.S. wedding businesses and help them try a complimentary wedding reel.



Why this role is worth your time:

• You do not need to find your own leads

• We provide the CRM, dialer, sales playbook, scripts, training materials, and coaching

• Every call is recorded so you can receive specific feedback and improve

• Our Local Presence system displays a clean local U.S. caller ID matching the prospect’s area code, which can improve answer rates

• There is a clear paid path from training to live calls and long-term work

• Base pay plus uncapped commissions rewards both consistency and results



Schedule:

• Monday-Friday only; no weekend calling

• 9:00 AM-1:00 PM in the local U.S. time zone assigned to your leads

• Four consecutive hours per day

• This normally means evening or overnight hours in the Philippines, depending on the assigned U.S. territory



Your responsibilities:

• Make 200 calls per day during your four-hour calling shift (50 calls per hour), both during the live trial and regular work

• Speak naturally and confidently with wedding photographers and studio owners

• Explain EditValue clearly and offer one complimentary wedding reel

• Ask useful questions, identify decision-makers, and follow up with interested studios

• Accurately record dispositions and notes in the CRM

• The key outcome is getting an interested wedding studio to send footage for its complimentary reel



Compensation after successfully completing the live trial:

• $480/month guaranteed base

• $20 for every qualified wedding studio that submits wedding footage

• Unlimited commissions



Your clear path into the role:

Initial application screening - Submit the short mock-call voice audition below, followed by the unpaid SDR scenario test if invited. This screening is separate from the five paid bootcamp stages.



1. SDR101 - Knowledge ($2): Learn EditValue’s service, the complimentary-reel offer, listening, and objection handling.

2. SDR102 - Voice Readiness ($5): Practice clear, warm, assured delivery and receive coaching through simulated conversations.

3. SDR103 - Call Training ($10): Complete and submit all 25 training calls, applying the feedback after each call.

4. SDR104 - Validation ($5): Complete a fresh assessment to demonstrate what you learned and how your performance improved.

5. SDR105 - One-Day Live Trial ($10): After approval and scheduling, use our dialer, CRM, and leads for a supervised live calling trial.



The five stages offer $32 in total. Stage completion, verification, and qualification are reviewed separately; payment is not automatic. We provide the applicable completion and payment-request instructions at each stage. Advancement requires meeting that stage’s requirements.



Longer-term opportunity - Strong performers may advance to further evaluation and ongoing employment.



Payments during the assessment process are made through PayPal, so you must be able to receive PayPal payments.



Who will do well:

• Excellent spoken English and clear pronunciation

• Confidence speaking with U.S. business owners

• Previous B2B, SDR, appointment-setting, or cold-calling experience is preferred

• Coachable, reliable, and willing to apply feedback quickly

• Comfortable working the stated U.S. hours

• Reliable computer, internet connection, and microphone

• Consistent, accurate CRM use



Learn about the service before applying: 



How to apply:

Send a 15-25 second voice recording.



Imagine Amanda, a wedding photography studio owner, just answered your call.

Deliver this opening like a skilled actor making the conversation feel real - with confidence, warmth, and clarity:



“Hi Amanda, I’m [Your name]. I help wedding studios catch up on editing. Do you need a hand with your highlight films or wedding reels?”



Smile as you speak. Sound assured and conversational, then end the recording.



While you record, make sure to avoid a dry reading, rushed words, a hesitant tone, or speaking too softly.



Perform the opening - not a self-introduction about your background.



Applications without a recording will not be considered.

title: Full-Stack Developer – Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
About MSTR



MSTR (
) is a specialized AI software company based in the Netherlands. We build custom AI-driven solutions that transform how businesses work – making them more productive, data-driven, and intelligent.



We're not just building software; we're pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI technology. From proof-of-concept to production-ready applications, we deliver end-to-end solutions that make a real impact.



This is a Long-Term Career Opportunity. We’re building a diverse team of developers who care about AI and technology, and we hire carefully, and look ten years ahead with every hire. Technology keeps changing, so we keep learning, and we work together to build things that matter.



We're looking for people who want to build a long-term career with us, not just find their next gig. We invest in our team members' growth, provide ongoing learning opportunities, and increase responsibility as you develop.



If you're seeking long-term stability, continuous learning, and the chance to work on cutting-edge AI projects, keep reading.



Location & Type

- Remote (work from anywhere in the Philippines)

- Full-time (40 hours/week)

- Long-term contractor position



What You'll Do



As a Full-Stack Developer at MSTR, you'll:

- Transform AI concepts into reality: Take proofs-of-concept and build production-ready applications

- Build modern web applications: Create responsive front-end (React) and robust REST APIs (Python/FastAPI)

- Integrate AI services: Connect AI models and services into seamless user experiences

- Collaborate with experts: Work alongside back-end developers, data scientists, and AI specialists

- Solve real problems: Proactively identify issues and propose elegant solutions

- Grow continuously: Learn new technologies, expand your skills, take on bigger challenges



What We're Looking For



Must-Have Skills:

- 1-3 years full-stack development experience

- Modern JavaScript/TypeScript  (React or similar frameworks)

- RESTful API development (Python back-end strongly preferred)

- Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail

- Excellent English communication (written and verbal)

- Growth mindset: Eager to learn, improve, and tackle new challenges

- Long-term focus: Looking for a career, not just a job



Nice-to-Have Skills:

- Experience with: FastAPI, Pydantic, Instructor

- Cloud platforms: Azure, GCP, or AWS

- DevOps tools: Docker, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines

- Database experience: PostgreSQL

- AI/ML curiosity or experience

- Git version control



Most Important:

We value potential and enthusiasm just as much as current technical skills. A driven junior developer with a strong foundation and hunger to learn is more valuable to us than an experienced developer without long-term commitment.



What We Offer:

- Competitive compensation and benefits

- Flexible remote work – work from anywhere in the Philippines

- Long-term partnership – we're investing in your long-term future with us

- Continuous learning – work with cutting-edge AI technology, modern tech stack

- Freedom to innovate – propose solutions, choose appropriate technologies

- Collaborative team – work with passionate, talented people

- Career growth – increasing responsibility and challenges as you develop

- Meaningful work – build applications that genuinely help businesses transform



Our Tech Stack



You'll work with modern, industry-leading technologies:

- Front-end: React, TypeScript

- Back-end: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic

- Database: PostgreSQL

- AI/ML: Various AI services and models

- Cloud: Azure (primary), with exposure to other platforms

- DevOps: Docker, CI/CD, Pulumi



How to Apply ( Please read all instructions. We will not entertain applications that do not follow instructions. ) 



IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please DO NOT apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a Short Video (3-7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and your journey as a developer.



2. Your technical skills: What are your key technical skills? Describe a challenging project you've worked on and how you solved it.



3. AI and technology: What interests you about working with AI technologies? Why does this excite you?



4. Learning approach: How do you approach learning new technologies? Give us a recent example.



5. Your next role: What would you like to achieve in your next role? Where do you see yourself in 5-10 years?



Video Guidelines:

- Length: 3-7 minutes total

- Production: No need for professional quality – we want to see the real you

- Authenticity: Share your own thoughts and personality—please do NOT read a ChatGPT-generated script because we notice immediately

- Language: English (this assesses your communication skills)

- Format: Any video format is fine (MP4, MOV, etc.)

- Hosting: Upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube (unlisted), or similar



Step 2: Submit Your Application

Send the following to 
 and 

1. Your video (link or attachment)

2. Your CV/Resume

3. Optional: Portfolio, GitHub profile, LinkedIn profile, or work samples



 Subject Line: "Full-Stack Developer Application - [Your Name]"



What Happens Next:

1. We'll review your video and CV within 2-3 days

2. If you're a strong match, we'll schedule an initial interview

3. Successful candidates move to technical evaluation

4. Final candidates meet with our founder

5. We aim to complete the entire process in 1-2 weeks



Who Should Apply

Apply if you:

- Want a long-term career in a high-performance organization

- Are excited about AI and modern technology

- Value continuous learning and growth

- Communicate well in English

- Are driven, reliable, and proactive

- Want to build meaningful applications



Don't apply if you:

- Only want short-term gigs or are juggling multiple clients

- Aren't willing to create a video response

- Don't have foundational full-stack skills

- Aren't interested in long-term commitment



Ready to Apply?



If you're excited about this opportunity and ready to build a long-term career with MSTR, we'd love to hear from you!



MSTR – Building the Future with AI

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper / Accounts Assistant - UK Shops | $3/hour
description:
We operate approximately 10 UK cafes, takeaways and retail shops. We are looking for a reliable part-time Bookkeeper / Accounts Assistant based in the Philippines to maintain accurate records and prepare clear reports.



PAY AND SCHEDULE

USD $3 per hour. Part-time, flexible work. Review each shop's WhatsApp group every three days; daily monitoring is not required. Record each trading day separately, even when processing several days together. Hours will be tracked, with a weekly hours limit agreed before starting. Please state your availability and expected time needed for this workload.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

- Collect Z reports, sales summaries, invoices, receipts and payment updates from the shop WhatsApp groups.

- Record cash, card and delivery-platform sales by shop and trading date.

- Record purchases, expenses, wages and supplier payments, with supporting documents.

- Check totals, prevent duplicate entries and clarify unclear figures with managers.

- Chase missing reports and receipts during each scheduled review.

- Keep each business's records separate and organised.

- Prepare weekly summaries and monthly reports showing sales, costs, draft profit/loss where sufficient information is available, and outstanding items.

- Use Google Sheets or Excel initially; experience with accounting software is welcome.



BANK RECONCILIATION AND ACCOUNTANT HANDOVER - ONE BUSINESS

We will also provide bank statements and supporting records for one business. You will match transactions to sales, invoices, receipts and payments; reconcile the bank accounts; flag unexplained transactions and missing documents; and prepare organised bookkeeping records and an outstanding-items list for our UK accountant's year-end accounts and tax work.



The UK accountant will review the accounts and handle tax submission. This role is bookkeeping and preparation, not independent tax filing. Do not guess missing figures or force accounts to balance. Keep transfers, loans and owner withdrawals separate from sales and operating expenses. Reconcile delivery-platform sales, fees and payouts without counting the same income twice.



REQUIREMENTS

- Practical bookkeeping and bank-reconciliation experience.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and attention to detail.

- Clear written English and confidence asking managers for missing information.

- UK retail, cafe or restaurant bookkeeping experience preferred.

- Understanding of cash reconciliation, supplier records, delivery-platform fees and the difference between cash movements and profit.

- Confidential handling of business and staff information.

- Reliable internet access and ability to meet agreed reporting deadlines.



HOW TO APPLY

Please start your application with DAYVIEW BOOKKEEPER and answer briefly:

1. What relevant bookkeeping and bank-reconciliation work have you personally done? Mention any UK retail or hospitality experience.

2. Which spreadsheet and accounting tools can you use confidently?

3. Share an existing redacted example of a report or reconciliation you prepared, if you have permission to share it. Do not disclose client data. A walkthrough of permitted existing work is also acceptable.

4. How would you handle a missing Z report, a duplicate receipt and a delivery-platform payout that differs from reported sales?

5. Confirm that USD $3/hour works for you, your earliest start, weekly availability and UK-time overlap. Explain how you would organise a review every three days across approximately 10 shops.



We value accuracy, clear communication and reliable follow-through. No new unpaid work or coding task is required to apply.

title: Google Ads Sales Closer | Fast Promotion & Pay Increases for Top Performers
description:
⚠️ READ BEFORE APPLYING



This role is for experienced sales closers only.



You must have direct experience selling Google Ads, PPC, SEO, or digital marketing services to business owners. This is not an appointment-setting job or an entry-level training opportunity.



- Starting salary: $500 USD/month, part-time, Level 1 Sales Representative

- Audit price:** $55.99

- Minimum performance floor: 5 paid audits per working day

- Target: 10 or more paid audits per working day

- Required: Voice sample and previous cold-call recording



If you cannot demonstrate real sales experience, please do not apply.



# GOOGLE ADS OUTBOUND SALES REPRESENTATIVE



Company: Digital Marketing Masters (DMM)  

Location: Remote  

Market: United States  

Employment: Part-Time



## ABOUT DMM



Digital Marketing Masters is a US digital marketing agency specializing in Google Ads management.



We have more than 1,000 businesses in our lead database that are currently running Google Ads. Our $55.99 Premium Google Ads Partner Audit introduces business owners to our expertise and creates opportunities for long-term management partnerships.



## YOUR ROLE



Your job is to contact business owners already running Google Ads, explain the audit, handle objections, and close paid sales during the initial conversation.



Your primary KPI is completed, paid audits, not calls made or appointments booked.



Responsibilities include:



- Speak directly with business owners and decision-makers.

- Ask five qualification questions using our sales script.

- Present and sell the $55.99 audit.

- Create Stripe payment links and help prospects complete checkout.

- Update sales and outcomes in HubSpot.

- Contact prospects during appropriate local business hours across US time zones.

- Move to the next prospect when a sale does not occur. No routine follow-ups are required.



There is no minimum outbound call requirement.



## PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



- Minimum: 5 paid audits per working day.

- Target: 10 or more paid audits per working day.



Five sales is the minimum performance floor, not the goal. Consistent sales results, professionalism, attendance, and accurate CRM records are expected.



## FAST ONBOARDING



Our goal is to have you up and running within 2 days.



We will help you set up your accounts, explain the product, walk you through Kixie, HubSpot, and Stripe, and provide the sales script and essential training.



You must be a fast learner who can quickly understand the process and transition into selling. We do not have a lengthy training period.



## COMPENSATION & CAREER GROWTH



Starting salary: $500 USD per month.



This is a part-time Level 1 Sales Representative position. Strong performers may qualify for advancement to higher sales levels with increased compensation based on demonstrated results.



## REQUIREMENTS



- Proven experience personally closing Google Ads, PPC, SEO, or digital marketing sales.

- Experience selling directly to business owners.

- Strong spoken English and confident phone communication.

- Ability to handle objections and ask for payment.

- Familiarity with a sales dialer, CRM, and Google Sheets.

- Reliable computer, high-speed internet, backup connection, and quiet workspace.

- Availability during appropriate US business hours across multiple time zones.



Experience selling digital marketing services to local businesses is strongly preferred.



## WHAT WE PROVIDE



- 1,000+ targeted business leads.

- Kixie Power Dialer and HubSpot CRM.

- Sales scripts and training materials.

- Objection-handling guidance.

- Stripe payment system.



## MANDATORY APPLICATION SCREENING



All five sections must be answered. Incomplete applications may be rejected.



1. Voice sample: Submit a 30-second Vocaroo recording introducing yourself and explaining your sales experience.



2. Sales experience: Describe the digital marketing services you have sold, industries served, and whether you personally closed customers.



3. Software experience: List your experience with Kixie or another dialer, HubSpot or another CRM, Google Sheets, and Stripe.



4. Previous cold-call recording: Provide an accessible link to an authorized recording demonstrating your sales ability.



5. Confirmation: Confirm that you accept the $500 monthly starting salary, part-time schedule, minimum of 5 paid audits per working day, and target of 10 or more daily sales.



## FINAL INSTRUCTION



Answer all five questions in order and include both recording links.



Appointment setters without direct closing experience should not apply. We want an experienced salesperson who can learn quickly, close paid audits, and help Digital Marketing Masters build a scalable customer acquisition channel.

- Inside joke

- Recognizable visual identity

RESPONSIBILITIES

WORK DETAILS

========================================



- 4 hours per day

========================================

title: 3D Visualiser – Photorealistic Renders from SketchUp – Australian Residential – PHP 70–90k/month
description:
Builder of custom and architectural homes, knockdown-rebuilds and commercial projects in Melbourne. We need a 3D visualiser whose renders look like photos of the finished home, good enough that a client signs off on finishes from them.



WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

A client should not be able to tell your render from a photo. Correct scale, real materials (stone, timber, tile, render, cladding), accurate lighting for the time of day, believable furniture and landscaping, and camera angles a real photographer would use. Interiors and exteriors, day and dusk.



SKETCHUP – REQUIRED

Our models come to you in SketchUp (some from ArchiCAD via export). You must work confidently from SketchUp files every day. If you can't render from SketchUp, please don't apply.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Take SketchUp models and produce photorealistic interior and exterior renders

- Apply real product finishes from our selections (colours, tiles, benchtops, cladding, fixtures)

- Produce render sets for client presentations, marketing and our website

- Produce walkthrough or flythrough videos where a job needs it

- Clean up and fix imported models so they render correctly

- Turn revisions around quickly from our designer's markups

- Work with our designer and project team



TOOLS

- Essential: SketchUp plus at least one of V-Ray, Enscape, Lumion, D5 Render or Twinmotion

- Nice to have: ArchiCAD, Photoshop post-production, 3ds Max / Corona, Unreal Engine



ABOUT YOU

- A portfolio of your MOST REALISTIC work on real residential projects, interiors and exteriors

- You understand light, materials and composition, not just software settings

- Fast AND accurate. We will ask how long each render took, and we will check.

- Clear written English; you take review comments well and turn them around quickly

- A machine that handles heavy scenes (32 GB RAM, strong dedicated graphics card, SSD) and stable, fast internet



HOURS AND PAY

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, overlapping Victorian business hours (Victoria is 2–3 hours ahead of Manila)

- PHP 70,000–90,000 per month, set by the realism and speed of your work

- 4-week paid trial, then a long-term role with a growing builder



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs. Applications missing any item below will not be assessed.



Subject line, exactly:  RENDER-SKP – [Your Full Name]



Include:

1. Your CV

2. A portfolio link showing your 5 MOST REALISTIC renders (interior and exterior) from real projects

3. For two of those renders, the SketchUp model screenshot next to the final render, as Google Drive links

4. Which render engine you used for each, and how many hours each took from model to final image

5. What work or clients are you committed to now, and what notice would you need? What are your PC specs (graphics card) and internet speed?



We read every application that follows the brief, and we will invite shortlisted applicants to a short paid test render.

Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong professional communication and stakeholder management skills.

Advanced organisational, reporting and documentation skills.



Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace and project management systems.

title: Customer Support Representative (Ad Tracking & Pixels)
description:
# Customer Support Representative (Ad Tracking & Pixels)



### Join the 
 Customer Support Team



At **
**, our mission is to help businesses get reliable, accurate tracking data for their advertising. We help e-commerce businesses improve their tracking setup and send valuable conversion data to advertising platforms, helping them better understand and optimize their advertising performance.



We're looking for a **Customer Support Representative with a technical mindset** to join our team. In this role, you'll help customers troubleshoot tracking issues, understand how our platform works, and get the most out of their advertising data.



You don't need to be an expert in every advertising platform. Experience with *
/Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, Snapchat Ads, Pinterest Ads, or other advertising and analytics tools** is a plus. We're equally interested in candidates who are curious, analytical, and eager to learn.



### Key Responsibilities



- **Live Chat Support:** Provide timely, helpful assistance to customers through live chat, answering questions and guiding them through the platform.

- **Technical Troubleshooting:** Investigate tracking discrepancies, integration issues, missing events, pixel-related problems, and other technical issues customers may encounter.

- **Tracking & Advertising Support:** Help customers understand how tracking works and assist them with configuring and troubleshooting their tracking setups across different advertising platforms.

- **Customer Education:** Explain technical concepts in simple terms, guide customers through solutions, and share relevant knowledge base articles and documentation.

- **Problem Investigation & Escalation:** Identify potential bugs or complex issues, gather the necessary information, document your findings, and collaborate with our technical team when further investigation is needed.

- **Product Feedback:** Share recurring customer issues, feedback, and improvement opportunities with the relevant teams to help us continuously improve our product.

- **Ticket Management:** Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and ensure that unresolved issues receive proper follow-up.



### Qualifications



- **Technical Problem-Solving:** You enjoy investigating problems, understanding how things work, and finding practical solutions. Previous troubleshooting or debugging experience is a plus.

- **Strong Written Communication:** You can communicate clearly and professionally in English, especially when explaining technical concepts through chat.

- **Analytical Mindset:** You can identify patterns, ask the right questions, and work methodically toward the root cause of an issue.

- **Customer-First Approach:** You're patient, proactive, and committed to helping customers achieve their goals.

- **Interest in Advertising & Tracking:** Familiarity with advertising platforms, conversion tracking, pixels, analytics, or e-commerce integrations is welcome.

- **Remote Work Skills:** You're comfortable working independently, managing your time, and collaborating with a remote team.



**Experience with any of the following is a plus, but not required:**

-
/Meta Ads and Meta Pixel

- Google Ads and Google Ads conversion tracking

- TikTok Ads and TikTok Pixel

- Snapchat Ads and Snap Pixel

- Pinterest Ads and Pinterest Tag

- Google Analytics, conversion events, or other tracking and analytics tools

- E-commerce platforms such as Shopify or WooCommerce

- APIs, browser debugging tools, or server-side tracking concepts



We don't expect you to know everything from day one. A willingness to learn, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate effectively are just as important as previous experience.



### Why 
?



- **Work from Anywhere:** Join a fully remote team and work from wherever you're most comfortable.

- **Flexible Hours:** Enjoy flexibility while collaborating with a distributed team.

- **Growth Opportunities:** Develop your technical expertise, deepen your understanding of advertising and data tracking, and grow with the company.

- **Learn a Specialized Skill Set:** Gain hands-on experience with advertising technology, e-commerce tracking, conversion data, and integrations across multiple platforms.

- **Make an Impact:** Help businesses improve their tracking and make better-informed advertising decisions.



### Ready to Apply?



If you're a problem-solver who enjoys technology, helping people, and learning new things, we'd love to hear from you.



**Please start your application with the word "tracking" to show that you've read the job post.**



Apply now and join the 
 team!

description:

We are looking for an experienced Order & Shipping Operations Specialist to monitor and manage orders across our multiple e-commerce stores.



Your main responsibility is to track every order from the moment it's placed until it has been successfully delivered to the customer.



We need someone who works proactively, identifies shipping issues early, and takes action before customers start complaining.



Responsibilities



Daily Order Monitoring: Check all open, unfulfilled, and in-transit orders across our Shopify stores.



Shipment Tracking: Monitor tracking updates and ensure orders are progressing normally toward delivery.



Delay Detection: Identify delayed shipments, stuck tracking, missing updates, and unusual shipping activity.



Proactive Customer Communication: Inform customers about delays or shipping issues before they contact support.



Supplier Communication: Contact suppliers and fulfillment partners about delayed, missing, or problematic orders and follow up until resolved.



Issue Resolution: Investigate lost packages, failed deliveries, incorrect addresses, and other shipping exceptions.



Open Order Management: Make sure no open orders are forgotten or left unresolved.



Delivery Confirmation: Follow orders through to successful delivery and investigate exceptions.



Reporting: Maintain a clear overview of delayed orders, shipping issues, supplier performance, and unresolved cases.



Requirements



Previous experience in e-commerce order management, fulfillment, or shipping operations.



Experience working with Shopify and order tracking systems.



Strong understanding of international shipping, tracking statuses, and delivery exceptions.



Excellent written English for customer and supplier communication.



Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive.



Comfortable managing orders across multiple stores.



Able to work independently and follow up consistently until issues are resolved.



What We're Looking For



We don't want someone who simply checks tracking numbers.



We want someone who takes full ownership of the entire order delivery process.



You should actively identify problems, communicate with the right people, and make sure every order receives the attention it needs until delivery is confirmed.



Our goal is simple: No forgotten orders, no unnoticed delays, and fewer customers contacting support about shipping issues.



How to Apply



Please send us:



Your experience with Shopify order management and shipment tracking.



Which tracking or fulfillment tools you've worked with.



How you would handle an order that has had no tracking updates for 7 days.



Your availability and expected hourly rate.

title: Civil Estimator / Takeoff Specialist (Remote – Full-Time)
description:
Help Increase Bid Capacity Through Accurate Construction Takeoffs!



Are you experienced in civil construction estimating and quantity takeoffs? Do you have a strong eye for detail and enjoy working with construction plans, measurements, and project quantities?



We are looking for a reliable, analytical, and detail-oriented Civil Estimator / Takeoff Specialist to support the estimating team of a growing U.S.-based construction company.



In this role, you will prepare accurate quantity takeoffs from construction drawings and specifications, helping senior estimators focus on final estimates and bid preparation.



Experience with AGTEK is highly preferred, but candidates with experience using comparable takeoff software may also be considered. The right candidate must be comfortable interpreting construction plans, performing accurate quantity calculations, asking questions when information is unclear, and learning established estimating workflows.



If you are proactive, coachable, and committed to producing accurate work, we would love to hear from you!



Key Responsibilities



Construction Quantity Takeoffs:

Review civil construction plans, drawings, specifications, and bid documents.

Prepare accurate 2D sitework quantity takeoffs.

Progress to utility takeoffs involving water, sewer, and storm systems.

Develop proficiency in 3D takeoffs and earthwork calculations as experience and training progress.

Organize takeoff results, calculations, and supporting documentation for the estimating team.



Plan Review & Quality Control:

Interpret construction drawings and identify relevant dimensions, quantities, and scope requirements.

Identify missing information, discrepancies, and conflicting details that could affect takeoff accuracy.

Double-check calculations and completed takeoffs before submission.

Ask questions when project information is unclear rather than making assumptions.

Incorporate feedback to improve accuracy and consistency.



Estimating Support & Documentation:

Maintain organized takeoff files and project documentation.

Communicate progress, outstanding questions, and potential issues proactively.

Prepare takeoff information in a clear format for senior estimators to review.

Follow established estimating procedures and meet agreed deadlines.

Help the team evaluate more bid opportunities by delivering reliable and accurate takeoffs.



Team Collaboration:

Work closely with the estimating team and participate in training and knowledge-sharing.

Communicate through Zoom,
, and messaging platforms.

Follow established workflows, templates, and quality standards.

Take ownership of assigned work while remaining receptive to guidance and feedback.



Qualifications



Experience in civil construction estimating, quantity takeoffs, or a related construction role.

Ability to read and interpret construction plans and specifications.

Experience performing accurate construction quantity takeoffs.

Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and analytical skills.

Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and communicate questions proactively.

Willingness to learn new software, follow established workflows, and incorporate feedback.



Software Requirements



AGTEK: Highly preferred.

Comparable software: Experience with Trimble Business Center, Bluebeam Revu, or similar construction takeoff software is an advantage.

Familiarity with CAD files and drawing layers is helpful; CAD design experience is not required.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and general digital documentation tools is beneficial.



Relevant takeoff experience and the ability to interpret construction plans are the primary considerations. Candidates without AGTEK experience may be considered if they have relevant experience with comparable software and demonstrate the ability to learn AGTEK.



Work Setup



Position: Civil Estimator / Takeoff Specialist

Employment Type: Full-Time, up to 40 hours per week

Work Arrangement: Remote

Initial Schedule: U.S. Eastern Time business hours to support training and collaboration

Long-Term Schedule Goal: Transition toward Philippine daytime hours, with some overlap with the U.S. team, so completed takeoffs are ready for review each morning

Communication: Zoom,
, and messaging platforms



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Updated Resume - highlighting your civil construction estimating and quantity takeoff experience.

title: Senior SEO & Conversion Strategist
description:
We’re Ezy Pzy Finance, an Australian company that connects small and medium businesses with fast business funding through a panel of lenders. Our sales, automation and paid ads are mature and well run. Organic search is our biggest untapped channel, and we want one senior person to own it completely.



This is not a “do the tasks we give you” role. You’ll d
 the strategy, build the plan, execute it, and be measured on one thing: funded deals from organic search.





What you’ll own:



- SEO strategy: audits, keyword mapping and prioritisation for a competitive finance niche

- Programmatic and landing pages: industry, situation and location pages at scale, each with real substance

- Content: articles with genuine buyer intent, plus refreshing existing pages

- Digital PR and link earning: turning our real lending data into reports journalists and finance sites want to cite, plus partnerships with accountants and industry bodies

- Conversion optimisation: A/B testing our landing pages and application flow, which also serves our paid traffic

- AI search visibility: getting us cited in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity

- Technical SEO: site health, schema, speed and internal linking, writing specs for our developer when needed

- Reporting: a monthly report tying organic traffic to leads and funded deals, not vanity rankings





You must have:



- 5+ years of hands-on SEO, including owning strategy (not just executing someone else’s)

- Proven results you can show: traffic and lead growth with screenshots from Search Console or Analytics

- Experience in finance, legal, health or another YMYL niche (strongly preferred)

- Conversion rate optimisation experience (A/B testing, landing page work)

- Strong written English, good enough to write content for Australian business owners

- Comfort with Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, GA4 and WordPress





What we offer:



- US$2,000–3,000/month base, depending on experience

- Uncapped commissions: 10% of our net commission on every new client funded through organic search (our average deal pays US$300+ to you)

- Paid tools (Ahrefs or Semrush) and a separate budget for PR and outreach

- Real ownership: you set the plan, with no micromanagement

- A long-term role in a stable, growing business





Hours of work

6am–3pm PH time





How to apply:

. Tell us the top 3 things you’d fix or build first and why, and what you’d deliberately not do.

Applications without the Loom video won’t be reviewed.

title: Blender Artist
description:
BLENDER ARTIST – 3D GEL NAIL ART & DIGITAL ASSET RENDERING



PAY: $5–8 USD/hour, depending on experience

TYPE: Freelance / Project-Based

LOCATION: Remote – Philippines

START DATE: Approximately 1–2 weeks after selection



ABOUT NAILZOTICA



Nailzotica is a beauty-tech platform featuring a digital nail art builder, creator marketplace, and AI-powered beauty experiences.



We are looking for a creative Blender artist to produce realistic, high-quality sculpted gel nail art assets for our mobile application.



IMPORTANT: Our app uses 2D images rendered from 3D models. We do not need real-time 3D models integrated into Flutter. The primary responsibility is creating realistic Blender models and exporting polished images with transparent backgrounds.



WHAT YOU'LL CREATE



- Sculpted gel flowers, including daisies, roses, and layered petals

- 3D hearts, stars, bows, butterflies, and decorative shapes

- Raised gel swirls, ribbons, droplets, and abstract designs

- Glossy, translucent, and textured gel embellishments

- Seasonal, trendy, and experimental nail art decorations



Assets should resemble realistic sculpted nail gel, not flat illustrations or cartoon graphics.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Create small decorative 3D objects in Blender using supplied references.

- Apply realistic gel materials with glossy, translucent, and dimensional finishes.

- Produce clean renders with realistic highlights, depth, and soft shadows.

- Export high-resolution PNG images with transparent backgrounds.

- Maintain consistent lighting, camera angles, scale, and positioning.

- Create reusable Blender materials and rendering templates to improve production efficiency.

- Organize and deliver original Blender project files alongside exported images.

- Make revisions when needed to meet quality standards.

- Prepare neutral or recolorable versions of assets that preserve realistic shading and highlights.



REQUIREMENTS



- Proficiency in Blender modeling, materials, lighting, and rendering.

- Ability to create polished small decorative objects efficiently.

- Experience producing transparent-background renders.

- Strong attention to detail and consistency.

- Ability to follow references and technical specifications.

- Reliable communication and organized file management.



Experience with nail art, beauty products, jewelry, cosmetics, or product visualization is a plus.



INITIAL PROJECT



Our initial goal is to create approximately 100 high-quality gel nail art assets, beginning with a small paid trial batch.



Most assets will be relatively simple decorative objects rather than complex character models or large 3D environments.



We value artists who can establish reusable workflows and produce consistently high-quality assets efficiently.



COMPENSATION AND CONTRACT TERMS



- Proposed rate: $5–8 USD/hour, negotiable based on experience and portfolio.

- Freelance, project-based engagement.

- Work will be assigned in batches according to project needs and available budget.

- No fixed weekly hours, minimum workload, or long-term contract are guaranteed.

- Additional assignments may be offered as our platform grows.

- Contractors must provide original work and agree to transfer the necessary commercial usage and ownership rights to Nailzotica upon payment.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following:



1. A link to your Blender portfolio, preferably featuring small decorative objects, glossy materials, or product renders.

2. Your desired hourly rate.

3. Your estimated time to create a simple sculpted gel flower or star, including rendering and export.

4. Your availability over the next 2–3 weeks.

5. Your experience exporting transparent PNG images.



Start your application with the phrase "Sculpted Gel Artist" so we know you read the posting.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a paid sample assignment before receiving a larger batch of work.

title: Remote Executive Assistant
description:
We’re seeking a proactive, highly organized Virtual Executive Assistant to support a global top 100 Poker Player with a dynamic lifestyle and multiple businesses. This role spans financial admin, travel coordination, property management, personal projects, and more. Ideal for a resourceful, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented professional.



This is a remote, part-time position (20 hours/week for first 1-4 weeks during trial period with plans for full-time, benefits and bonuses). Requiring 1-2 hours overlap with Pacific Time when it’s needed to reach out to businesses that may only be open 8-5 PST for example. Must be comfortable with presenting with a masculine-sounding voice for outgoing calls on behalf of the Business Owner. Typically we’d have 1 video meeting per week on Monday or Tuesdays to discuss the priorities and other work is flexible to be completed on your own time with due dates in mind.



Key Responsibilities

• Manage calendars, inboxes, scheduling, prioritization, and follow-through

• Coordinate travel including flights, hotels, transportation, and itineraries

• Track and organize expenses; Build and maintain spreadsheet-based reports

• Liaise with accountants for reporting, filings, or compliance support

• Conduct poker simulations to analyze game strategy and decision making

• Support property-related needs such as scheduling vendors, services, and invoices

• Conduct online research for vendors, pricing, products, and market data

• Order items and track deliveries/returns

• Coordinate gifts and services when needed

• Book personal appointments - health, wellness, dining, etc.

• Administrative tasks including streamlining personal and business systems

• Learn new tools independently and proactively research solutions without needing step-by-step instruction



Requirements

• Excellent spoken and written English with clear, professional communication.

• Prior experience with bookkeeping, financial admin, spreadsheets, or data reporting is strongly preferred

Prior experience with research, travel planning, or financial admin is strongly preferred.

• Enjoys learning new tools: Google Workspace, Asana, Claude, ChatGPT, Canva, financial and travel platforms.

• High integrity, ownership mindset, and commitment to delivering accurate, timely, polished work.

• Ability to work autonomously while being accessible for periodic check-ins (e.g., short AM/PM PST windows).



Benefits

• Offer education and office reimbursements and other performance based bonuses for full time employees

• Flexible remote work with weekly check-ins to align the agenda for the week

• Opportunity to learn new systems, take on higher-level projects, and grow with the businesses

Please submit your application through the form below. Only candidates who complete the form will be considered. Resumes need to be up to date including months + year to show total duration in a role/company.

title: Customer Retention Specialist (Part-Time, US Customers)
description:
Type of work: Part-time

Hours: 20 hours a week, 4 hours a day, 5 days a week

Schedule: Wednesday to Sunday, 2:00 PM to 6:00 PM US Eastern (Thursday to Monday, 2:00 AM to 6:00 AM Philippine time)

Salary: TBD



About us



Redwood Remedies is a US telehealth company offering prescription men’s health treatment by subscription. Our customers are mostly men in their 50s and 60s across the US, and many of them call us with a question before their next refill. We’re looking for someone who enjoys those conversations and can keep a customer with us when a well-timed call makes the difference.



What you’ll do



You’ll own our retention calls each shift. Most of your time goes to calling customers a few days before their subscription renews to check how the treatment is going, answer questions and help them pick the plan that suits them. When a customer asks to cancel or pause, you’ll call to understand why and walk them through the options we can offer, such as a different product, a pause or a one-time order. You’ll also contact customers whose payment didn’t go through and help them update their card.



You’ll record every outcome during the call: updating the subscription in our admin panel and payment system, and logging the call in our CRM (GoHighLevel). When one of our two support agents is out, you’ll pick up extra hours to cover support, which includes inbound calls, texts and
.



What we’re looking for



At least 1 year in retention, save desk, account management or subscription customer service for US customers, ideally by phone

Clear, natural spoken English and comfort speaking with older American customers about a sensitive health topic

Comfort handling objections and making an offer, while respecting a customer’s decision when they want to leave

Careful notes. Every call gets logged accurately, the same day. To show us you read closely, put the word SEQUOIA in the subject line of your application.

Experience with a CRM. GoHighLevel, HubSpot or similar is a plus

Available 2:00 AM to 6:00 AM Philippine time, Thursday to Monday, including US weekends

Flexibility to add hours on short notice when a teammate is out

A quiet workspace, a reliable computer, a noise-cancelling headset and a stable internet connection with a backup



What we offer



Compensation package: TBD

Fully remote, with a small team that works together on Slack

Training on our products, systems and offers before you take your first call



How to apply



Please send:



Your resume

A short note about a time you kept a customer who wanted to cancel: what they said, what you offered, and how it ended

A link to a 5-minute video introduction, candid and unscripted. Tell us about yourself, your experience with customers, and why this role interests you. Speak naturally; we’d rather see how you really talk than a polished script.



Applications missing any of the items above won’t be reviewed.

About Us



We are an international beauty and skincare manufacturing company working with beauty brands worldwide. We specialize in product development, manufacturing, packaging, and international distribution, with operations involving South Korea and other global markets.



About the Role



We’re looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive Korean-Speaking Procurement & Operations Coordinator to support our purchasing, supplier coordination, logistics, and day-to-day operations in South Korea.



You’ll work closely with our Operations, Product Development, and Korea-based teams, communicating directly with Korean suppliers and service providers who may not speak English.

* Communicate with Korean suppliers through
, phone calls, and KakaoTalk.

Logistics & Customs

* Assist clients’ appointed freight forwarders when Korean-language communication is needed.

* Coordinate shipping documents, customs clearance, shipment arrangements, and deliveries.

* Help resolve shipping delays and documentation issues.



Supplier Quality Coordination



* Communicate with Korean suppliers regarding defective materials, incorrect specifications, and other quality concerns.

* Coordinate investigations, corrective actions, replacements, and rework.

* Follow up on supplier-related issues until resolved.



General Operations

title: QuickBooks ProAdvisor – Accounting Reviewer & Administrative Support (Part-Time, Potential Full-Time)
description:
IMPORTANT: ALL AI-GENERATED APPLICATION RESPONSES WILL BE IMMEDIATELY REJECTED AND WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED. We are looking for applicants who personally read this job description and write their own original responses based on their actual experience and qualifications.



JOB TITLE: QuickBooks ProAdvisor – Accounting Reviewer & Administrative Support (Part-Time, Potential Full-Time)



JOB OVERVIEW



We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented QuickBooks Online (QBO) ProAdvisor to join our team as an Accounting Reviewer and Administrative Support Specialist.



This role is ideal for an accounting professional with strong technical knowledge, excellent analytical skills, and hands-on experience reviewing financial statements and QuickBooks Online files for accuracy, completeness, and proper accounting treatment.



You will work closely with our bookkeeping team to review weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end financials, identify discrepancies, provide constructive feedback, and maintain the quality and accuracy of our clients’ accounting records.



This position starts at 20–25 hours per week, with the potential to transition to a full-time role based on performance, business needs, and mutual fit.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, take ownership of the review process, identify issues without constant supervision, communicate findings clearly, and consistently maintain high accounting standards.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. FINANCIAL STATEMENT AND PERIOD-END REVIEWS

* Review weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial statements and accounting reports.

* Review period-end financials submitted through our firm's client portal.

* Verify the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of financial statements.

* Identify unusual balances, discrepancies, misclassifications, and potential accounting errors.

* Verify that balance sheet accounts are properly reconciled and supported by appropriate documentation.

* Review profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and other financial reports for accuracy and reasonableness.

* Provide clear, actionable feedback on issues identified during the review process.



2. QUICKBOOKS ONLINE REVIEW AND QUALITY CONTROL

* Review client QuickBooks Online (QBO) files for accuracy, completeness, and proper accounting treatment.

* Evaluate account classifications, journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.

* Identify missing transactions, incorrect postings, unreconciled accounts, and other inconsistencies.

* Assess the overall quality and reliability of clients’ accounting records.

* Recommend adjustments, corrections, and process improvements when necessary.



3. BOOKKEEPER PERFORMANCE MONITORING

* Track and monitor bookkeepers’ accounting review scores and performance trends.

* Maintain organized records of review findings, recurring errors, and areas for improvement.

* Provide constructive, professional, and actionable feedback to bookkeepers.

* Identify recurring mistakes and recommend corrective actions or additional training.

* Help establish and maintain consistent accounting review standards across the team.



4. TAX RETURN TIE-OUTS

* Tie out tax return figures to the corresponding QuickBooks Online records and financial statements.

* Verify that key balances and financial figures agree with accounting records and tax return workpapers.

* Investigate and document discrepancies between the books and tax reporting figures.

* Coordinate with appropriate team members to resolve outstanding differences.



5. ACCOUNTING ANALYTICS AND FINANCIAL REVIEW

* Perform accounting analytics to identify unusual fluctuations, trends, and potential errors.

* Compare financial results across periods and investigate significant variances.

* Identify inconsistent account activity, unusual transactions, and items requiring further review.

* Provide insights and recommendations to improve the accuracy and reliability of financial reporting.



6. ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT

* Access assigned client files through our firm's client portal, review submissions, and track outstanding items.

* Maintain accurate documentation of review findings, corrections, and follow-up actions.

* Monitor assigned reviews and communicate outstanding issues promptly.

* Assist with other accounting review, quality control, reporting, and administrative tasks as needed.

* Help improve internal accounting workflows, review procedures, and quality assurance processes.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Familiarity with accounting workflow and practice management portals.

* Experience working with U.S.-based businesses and U.S. accounting practices.

* Proven experience in accounting, bookkeeping review, financial reporting, or public accounting.

* Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online (QBO). QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification is strongly preferred.

* Solid understanding of accrual accounting, month-end and year-end closing procedures, and financial statement preparation.

* Experience reviewing balance sheets, profit and loss statements, general ledgers, and account reconciliations.

* Familiarity with financial statement review procedures and internal quality control processes.

* Experience reviewing tax returns and tying tax figures back to accounting records.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify accounting errors, discrepancies, and inconsistencies.

* Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to accurate, high-quality work.

* Strong written communication skills, particularly when documenting issues and providing feedback.

* Ability to work independently, manage multiple client files, and meet deadlines.

* Professionalism and the ability to handle confidential financial information responsibly.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent professional accounting qualification.

* Experience in a CPA firm, accounting firm, or multi-client bookkeeping environment.

* Experience evaluating bookkeeper performance and providing technical accounting guidance.



WORK SCHEDULE AND GROWTH OPPORTUNITY:

Initial commitment: Approximately 20–25 hours per week.

Position type: Part-time, with the potential to transition to full-time.

Work arrangement: Remote.

Required schedule (Pacific Time):

* Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday: 11:00 AM–3:00 PM or 12:00 PM–4:00 PM.

* Wednesday: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM.

* Mandatory weekly team meeting every Wednesday.



You must be able to follow the agreed schedule, attend mandatory meetings, coordinate with the team, and meet deadlines.



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship with our firm.

The role may expand into a full-time position as our firm grows and the successful candidate demonstrates strong performance, reliability, initiative, and the ability to take ownership of the accounting review function.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We want more than someone who simply checks numbers. We need an accounting professional who can think critically, identify problems before they become bigger issues, uphold high accounting standards, and help our bookkeepers continuously improve.



The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, dependable, analytical, and comfortable working with multiple client files. You should be able to recognize when something does not look right, investigate the underlying cause, and communicate your findings clearly and professionally.



We value accuracy, accountability, initiative, independent problem-solving, and a commitment to continuous improvement.



This is a hands-on accounting review role. We expect you to apply your own accounting knowledge and judgment, not simply rely on automated tools or follow checklists without understanding the underlying transactions.



HOW TO APPLY

Please read the entire job description carefully before submitting your application. Applications that do not follow the instructions below will not be considered.



To confirm that you have personally read this job description, include the exact code below in the subject line of your application or proposal: abblrocks

Applications without this exact subject line will be rejected.



Please address each of the following in your application using your own words (please make it short and direct to the point):



1. LOCATION: What country and city do you currently reside in?



2. ACCOUNTING EXPERIENCE: Briefly describe your relevant accounting experience and professional qualifications.



3. QUICKBOOKS ONLINE: Explain your hands-on experience with QBO, including any ProAdvisor certification you hold.



4. FINANCIAL STATEMENT REVIEWS: Describe your experience reviewing financial statements and identifying accounting discrepancies.



5. TAX RETURN TIE-OUTS: Explain your experience reconciling tax return figures with accounting records.



6. U.S. ACCOUNTING EXPERIENCE: Describe your experience working with U.S.-based clients or accounting firms.



7. AVAILABILITY AND RATE: State your weekly availability, ability to follow the required schedule, and proposed hourly rate.



8. PROBLEM-SOLVING EXAMPLE: Share a brief example of an accounting issue you personally identified during a review, how you investigated it, and what you did to resolve it. Do not disclose confidential client information.



We value specific examples and genuine explanations over generic statements. Your answers should reflect your actual experience and demonstrate your ability to perform the responsibilities outlined above.



CONFIDENTIALITY AND PERSONAL WORK REQUIREMENTS

This engagement involves highly confidential personal and business financial information. All work must be performed personally by the selected freelancer.



Delegation, subcontracting, the use of assistants, and unauthorized third-party access to client information or accounting systems are strictly prohibited.



You must be able to work independently, protect sensitive client data, follow our internal procedures, and take personal responsibility for the quality and accuracy of your work.



FINAL NOTE

We are looking for a reliable, analytical, and technically strong accounting professional who takes initiative, communicates clearly, identifies problems independently, and follows through on solutions.



If you have the experience, judgment, and attention to detail required for this role, we encourage you to apply with a thoughtful, personalized proposal that demonstrates your qualifications.



We look forward to finding a strong accounting professional who can contribute to our team's success and grow with our firm.

title: Cold Caller, US Property Owners (Real Estate / Property Management)
description:

- Real estate or property management calling strongly preferred

Pay

- $5.00 per hour, paid biweekly through Payoneer

- One-week unpaid trial after hire

- Performance and rate review at 3 to 6 months



How to apply

1. Start your application with the word Detroit.

2. Attach or link one or two recordings of real outbound calls you made to US homeowners or property owners. Remove or bleep the other person's name and number.

3. Tell us in two sentences what real estate calling you have done and for whom.



Applications without a call recording will not be reviewed.



Before any offer, shortlisted applicants complete a short Loom video, two references from direct supervisors, an assessment, an interview, and a short paid test calling block on our list.

title: AI UGC Scriptwriter
description:
About the Role



We’re hiring a part-time AI UGC Scriptwriter to join our growing content production team.



We specialize in creating AI-generated UGC-style videos for beauty, skincare, and haircare brands.



Our creative director will provide reference videos, scripts, and creative direction. Your responsibility is to adapt those references into engaging, ready-to-produce scripts tailored to different AI avatars, brand voices, and ideal customer profiles (ICPs).



This is a writing-focused position. You won’t be responsible for finding reference videos, editing videos, or generating AI visuals.



We’re looking for someone who knows how to use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT effectively while understanding what makes short-form video content engaging and persuasive.



Responsibilities



* Review reference videos and creative instructions provided by our team.

* Understand each avatar’s personality, speaking style, and ideal customer profile (ICP).

* Use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar AI tools to adapt reference scripts.

* Preserve the original reference’s hook, structure, pacing, and creative concept unless instructed otherwise.

* Adapt dialogue naturally to match the assigned avatar and target audience.

* Incorporate the correct brand and product information into each script.

* Review and refine AI-generated scripts to ensure they sound natural and conversational.

* Check scripts for inaccurate product information, unsupported claims, and inconsistencies.

* Include scene directions and visual instructions when requested.

* Complete 8 finalized scripts per working day, 6 days per week.

* Make revisions based on feedback.

* Communicate proactively about questions, issues, or delays.



You’re a Good Fit If You:



* Write in clear, natural, fluent English.

* Have experience using Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar AI writing tools.

* Understand what makes short-form video hooks engaging.

* Can take an existing reference script and adapt it without losing the original creative direction.

* Can write natural dialogue that doesn’t sound overly robotic or AI-generated.

* Are detail-oriented and capable of following specific creative instructions.

* Are organized, reliable, and open to constructive feedback.

* Can work independently with minimal supervision.



Experience with TikTok, Instagram Reels, AI UGC, or direct-response advertising is a plus.



Tools You’ll Use



* Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini — AI-assisted scriptwriting.

* Google Drive — Reference videos and shared assets.

* Google Docs — Script submissions and revisions.

* 
 / WhatsApp — Team communication, daily updates, and feedback.



What We Provide



* Reference videos and creative direction for each assignment.

* Established AI avatar identities and target audience profiles.

* Brand guidelines, product information, and writing examples.

* Training on our scriptwriting workflow.

* Regular feedback to help improve your writing.

* Opportunities to take on additional work as our team grows.



Compensation



* $100–$200 USD monthly base, depending on experience and skill level.

* Workload: 8 finalized scripts per day, 6 days per week.

* Estimated hours: 14 hours per week.

* Schedule: Flexible, based on completing assigned scripts.



As our production team expands, we may increase output to 12 scripts per day, with corresponding adjustments to compensation.



How to Apply



Send a message or apply to this job AND complete the application questionnaire below:







The questionnaire includes a mandatory AI scriptwriting recreation assignment.



We'll only consider applicants who complete the questionnaire and assignment.



We’re not just looking at the final script. We want to understand how you think, follow creative direction, and use AI tools to produce high-quality content.

title: Purchasing Agent (NetSuite) - Own Every PO & Push Back on Vendors
description:
We're a US flooring and tile distributor based in Dallas, TX. We need a purchasing agent who OWNS this job - not someone who just processes it.



READ THIS FIRST

This role is not for someone who waits for instructions. We want someone who:

- Questions a vendor price increase instead of accepting it

- Catches errors before they reach a PO, and asks when something doesn't add up

- Chases late shipments without being reminded

- Tells us about a problem early, along with a proposed fix

- Is comfortable telling a vendor no, and comfortable telling us when something's wrong



If you'd rather keep your head down and stay quiet, this isn't the job for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own purchasing end to end in NetSuite: PO creation, tracking, receipt and data accuracy

- Negotiate. Treat every vendor price as negotiable and fight increases on timing, volume or substitutions

- Track lead times and escalate delays immediately

- Verify and upload vendor price lists, including bulk CSV uploads

- Manage customer orders that require procurement: send status updates and coordinate delivery with our warehouse and logistics teams

- Cover quoting and order intake when needed



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 3 years of purchasing or procurement experience in distribution or manufacturing

- Hands-on NetSuite experience (required): POs, vendor records, inventory and CSV imports

- Strong Excel skills

- Fluent, confident spoken and written English

- Must work US Central business hours (8am-5pm CT), Monday to Friday

- Import experience (tile, stone, LVT) is a plus



ENGAGEMENT

Full-time (40 hrs/week), long-term. Paid trial period first.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "Vantage" and answer these:

1. A vendor
s a 6% price increase effective in two weeks. Write the actual reply you would send them.

2. Tell us about a time you pushed back on a vendor, a customer, or your boss. What happened?

3. You're entering a PO and the item cost doesn't match the last PO. What do you do?

4. Describe your NetSuite experience: which transactions did you create day to day, and have you done CSV imports?

5. Can you reliably work 8am-5pm US Central, Monday to Friday?



Applications that don't start with "Vantage" will be skipped, because following instructions is part of this job.

title: UGC & Creator Partnerships Manager
description:
Creator Recruitment, Briefing & Analytics



Remote | A$1,500 monthly base | Proposed full time at 40 hours per week | Long-term role



MINA is a voice AI companion for older people, focused on conversation and keeping families connected.



We are building MINA’s creator programme from the ground up and want someone who can manage it, working directly with founder Boris Gefter.



You will find creators who already talk about caring for their mum, dad, grandparents or other older relatives. The aim is to recruit 20–50 creator households across suitable markets. We will begin with a small pilot and offer six months of agreed MINA access, with the possibility of extending it to twelve months through actual participation.



What you will own



• Research and approach relevant creators on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and other suitable channels. Check their content, communication and fit; large followings are optional.



• Negotiate clear offers and manage the process from first contact to onboarding, genuine household use, content delivery and ongoing participation.



• Write concise briefs with useful hooks, believable demonstrations, clear calls to action and practical filming instructions. Review assets and give specific feedback.



• Maintain the creator database, deadlines, agreements, permissions, asset library and next actions. Schedule feedback sessions with Boris and route product issues promptly.



• Track creator activity and campaign results. Connect links and creative assets to installs, trials where offered, paid subscriptions and retention. Explain what the data can and cannot show.



What you need



• Preferably 3+ years of relevant experience and evidence of a sustained employer or client relationship lasting at least two years. Explain shorter engagements in context.



• A portfolio showing creator recruitment, campaign briefs or UGC campaigns you personally managed, with measurable outcomes where available.



• Working knowledge of direct-response creative, conversion metrics and spreadsheets; actual experience using an MMP such as AppsFlyer, Adjust or Branch. Engineering will implement SDK changes.



• Clear written and spoken English, reliable follow-through, good judgement and confidence managing several creator relationships at once.



How we work



We are hiring someone based in the Philippines. If you are an experienced fractional operator, state the hours you can commit at the advertised budget. We will agree working hours and Sydney overlap before appointment. Approved programme costs are handled separately from your base pay.



Apply with your CV, LinkedIn profile, relevant portfolio and answers to every question below. Shortlisted applicants may be invited to a paid 90-minute practical exercise. We are looking for specific evidence of what you have done. Client details may be anonymised.



Application questions



Please answer all ten questions in order. Applications with missing answers will not be reviewed. A CV or portfolio alone is incomplete. If you have no experience in an area, say so. Keep answers concise and link to supporting examples.



1. Is A$1,500 per month acceptable for the proposed 40-hour week? State your current location, time zone, Sydney overlap, notice period and earliest start date. If applying on a fractional basis, state the hours you can commit at that budget.



2. List your two longest relevant employer or client relationships, with start and end month/year, role and whether each was employment or a freelance retainer. What did you personally own?



3. Describe one creator programme you managed. Over what period, how many creators did you approach, sign, activate and retain, and how many usable assets were delivered? State which parts you owned.



4. Share two examples of creator content you briefed or managed. Explain the hook, audience, product demonstration, objection handled and call to action. Include conversion results you can substantiate.



5. How would you find creators who already talk publicly about caring for an older parent or grandparent and could use MINA with their family?



a) Name the first two platforms or public communities you would search. Give 3–5 exact search phrases or hashtags and explain how you would narrow the results by country, language or care context.



b) Explain the steps from finding a relevant post to locating the creator’s profile and published business-contact or DM route.



c) How would you check family-care relevance, content quality, genuine household interest and responsiveness? Explain what you can assess before contact and what you would confirm through replies and follow-through.



Keep your answer to about 150 words. Use previous work where helpful.



6. Share an anonymised example of an outreach message you previously wrote for a creator campaign. Describe a past fee negotiation: what the creator requested, how you responded and the outcome. Use existing work; no new MINA outreach copy is required.



7. Which MMPs and analytics products have you actually used, including AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch or GA4? For each, explain what you did and describe one campaign or event report you worked with.



8. How would you measure the path from a creator link to install, trial where offered, paid subscription and retained use? What could attribution miss? How would you exclude gifted creator households from paid acquisition results?



9. Show an anonymised tracker or describe the fields and weekly routine you would use to manage 50 creators, onboarding, usage, briefs, rights, deadlines and follow-ups.



10. Tell us about a creator campaign that underperformed or missed a deadline. What did the data or conversations reveal, what did you change and what happened next?

Communicate day to day through Google Chat

Compensation

How to Apply

Our Hiring Process

title: Student Accounts & Collections Officer
description:
Company: Alpha Technical Training

Employment Type: Part-time

Work Arrangement: Remote / Offshore

Industry: Vocational Education & Training (Australia)



ABOUT THE ROLE:



Alpha Technical Training is seeking a proactive, commercially minded Student Accounts & Collections Officer to manage outstanding student payments and maximise cash collection.



This is not a traditional payment reminder or administrative follow-up role.



We are looking for someone who knows how to have difficult financial conversations, negotiate payment arrangements, overcome objections and turn outstanding balances into successful collections.



Many of our students are working professionals completing trade qualifications. They may experience financial difficulties, competing priorities or delays in completing their payments.



Your responsibility is to understand their circumstances, identify practical solutions and negotiate mutually acceptable payment arrangements while maintaining positive student relationships.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



1. Payment Recovery & Negotiation

- Proactively contact students with outstanding course fees.

- Understand the actual reasons behind delayed payments.

- Negotiate realistic payment arrangements within company-approved guidelines.

- Offer structured instalment plans where appropriate.

- Secure specific payment commitments, including amounts and dates.

- Follow through on commitments until payments are received.

- Identify opportunities to recover overdue balances earlier without placing unreasonable pressure on students.



2. Objection Handling & Problem Solving

- Confidently handle objections such as:

“I can’t afford to pay right now.”

“I’ll pay next month.”

“I’m waiting for my salary.”

“I’m too busy.”

“I’ll get back to you.”

- Ask effective questions to understand the student’s financial circumstances.

- Explore alternative arrangements rather than accepting the first objection.

- Identify genuine financial hardship and escalate cases requiring special consideration.

- Know when to negotiate, when to follow up and when to escalate.



3. Student Relationship Management

- Build trust and maintain professional relationships with students.

- Explain outstanding balances, payment deadlines and agreed arrangements clearly.

- Help students understand the administrative and contractual implications of outstanding payments without making misleading statements or threats.

- Maintain a supportive but commercially focused communication style.

- Resolve payment-related concerns and disputes professionally.



4. CRM Management & Reporting

- Maintain accurate payment notes and follow-up records in 
.

- Record objections, payment commitments, agreed instalments and next actions.

- Monitor overdue balances and broken payment arrangements.

- Provide daily collection reports and weekly cashflow forecasts.

- Identify students with high recovery potential and prioritise accordingly.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS:



- Success in this role will be measured by:

- Total outstanding cash successfully collected.

- Percentage of overdue balances recovered.

- Payment commitments successfully converted into receipts.

- Number and value of realistic payment arrangements negotiated.

- Reduction in overdue account balances.

- Quality of student communication and compliance with collection procedures.

- We value actual collections and sustainable payment arrangements, not simply the number of calls made.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:



- Minimum 2 years’ experience in credit collection, accounts receivable, debt recovery or payment negotiation.

- Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident conducting payment discussions over the phone.

- Ability to build rapport while maintaining a clear collection objective.

- Commercial mindset with strong problem-solving ability.

- Experience using CRM systems and maintaining accurate records.

- Ability to work independently and achieve collection targets.



HIGHLY DESIRABLE:



- Experience collecting education or training fees.

- Experience working with Australian customers.

- Experience negotiating instalment arrangements.

- Familiarity with 
 or similar CRM platforms.
