Location: Remote 

Schedule: Full-Time | 40 Hours/Week | U.S. Mountain Time

Compensation: $4,000 USD/Month (Base + Performance Bonuses)

Website: 



Are you already exceptional at sales, customer communication, CRM management, and building relationships? Do you consistently produce results, identify opportunities, and take initiative without needing constant direction?



We're hiring an experienced Sales & Marketing Manager to convert inquiries into paying customers, improve sales follow-up, build referral partnerships, and drive business growth.



IMPORTANT: This is NOT a technical digital marketing role. You don't need experience managing Google Ads,
 Ads, websites, or advanced CRM automations. Other specialists handle those responsibilities.



We want someone who excels at connecting with people, closing sales, managing customer relationships, and executing practical marketing and outreach strategies.



This is NOT an entry-level position. We're looking for an A player with proven skills, strong judgment, and a history of measurable results. 



We provide the tools, resources, and goals. You bring the expertise, initiative, and ability to execute.





About Boarding & Beyond:

Founded in 1996, Boarding & Beyond has spent 30 years making a difference in the lives of dogs and the families who love them. Located in Aurora, Colorado, USA, we provide dog daycare, boarding, and grooming services.  Our mission is simple: Change dogs' lives for the better while giving pet parents peace of mind. 



We believe exceptional businesses are built by exceptional people. Our culture values customer service, ownership, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.  We're looking for a highly capable professional who wants to make a meaningful contribution to our continued growth.



Your Mission: Generate More Paying Customers



Your primary responsibility will be to help Boarding & Beyond acquire new customers, convert more inquiries into bookings, and increase repeat business.



We already receive inquiries from dog owners interested in our services. Your first priority will be making sure those opportunities turn into paying customers.



Beyond sales conversion, you'll take ownership of customer follow-up, CRM execution, referral generation, local business outreach, and organic marketing initiatives.



You'll be responsible for executing proven strategies, identifying improvements, and producing measurable results.



Your Key Responsibilities



1. Sales & Lead Conversion — Your #1 Priority



- Personally call, text, and
 prospective customers to convert inquiries into bookings.

- Proactively follow up with leads who haven't booked.

- Build rapport, establish trust, handle objections, and close sales.

- Identify missed sales opportunities and recover potential customers.

- Improve sales scripts, follow-up strategies, and booking conversion rates.

- Track leads, sales activity, and conversion performance.

- Take ownership of ensuring qualified opportunities don't get overlooked.



We're looking for someone who is already confident, persuasive, and effective at selling over the phone.



2. CRM Management & Sales Optimization



You'll use GoHighLevel to manage leads, customer communication, follow-up, and sales opportunities.



- Keep CRM records organized, accurate, and actionable.

- Manage sales pipelines and ensure timely follow-up.

- Review recorded customer calls to identify missed sales opportunities and customer service issues.

- Recommend and implement improvements that increase conversions.

- Execute customer follow-up and reactivation campaigns.

- Identify inefficiencies and improve existing CRM processes.

- Monitor and report performance.



We want someone who understands how to use a CRM to generate revenue—not someone who simply enters data.



3. Community Outreach & Referral Partnerships



- Proactively contact veterinarians, apartment communities, pet stores, and other local businesses.

- Develop relationships that generate new customer referrals.

- Confidently make outbound calls, present partnership opportunities, and handle objections.

- Create consistent follow-up processes for potential partners.

- Develop and execute customer referral programs.

- Track which partnerships and campaigns generate paying customers.



You should already be comfortable initiating conversations, building relationships, and creating new business opportunities.



4. Customer Retention & Reactivation



- Reengage inactive customers and encourage repeat bookings.

- Execute targeted
 and SMS campaigns.

- Identify opportunities to increase customer retention.

- Encourage and track customer referrals.

- Improve communication throughout the customer experience.

- Measure campaign results and continuously improve performance.



5. Marketing & Online Community Engagement



- Promote Boarding & Beyond in relevant local
 groups and online communities.

- Identify opportunities to reach local dog owners.

- Create and schedule social media posts using photos and videos we provide.

- Encourage authentic customer reviews and monitor online reputation.

- Execute organic marketing campaigns that generate inquiries and bookings.

- Identify, test, and improve customer acquisition strategies.



Paid advertising, website development, and advanced technical CRM development are handled separately.



Your focus is execution that produces customers and revenue—not marketing activity for its own sake.





Who We're Looking For



We want an experienced, highly capable professional with a demonstrated history of success.



You Must Already Be Strong In:



Sales & Closing

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident, persuasive phone communication with U.S. customers.

- Strong lead follow-up and objection-handling skills.

- A demonstrated ability to convert inquiries into paying customers.

- The ability to independently manage sales conversations from initial contact through booking.



CRM & Customer Relationship Management

- Experience managing leads, pipelines, and follow-up using CRM software.

- Understanding of how to improve sales conversion through effective follow-up.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to recognize sales process problems and recommend practical solutions.



Marketing & Business Development

- Experience executing marketing or customer acquisition initiatives.

- Ability to research prospects, conduct outreach, and develop relationships.

- Understanding of referrals, retention, and customer engagement.

- Ability to measure performance and improve results.



Independent Execution & Ownership

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

- Ability to prioritize high-impact work without constant supervision.

- Initiative to identify and solve problems independently.

- A track record of reliably completing commitments.

- A genuine desire to improve performance and contribute ideas.





We care far more about demonstrated performance than degrees, certifications, or impressive-sounding job titles.



You don't need to know the pet care industry. But you should already be highly competent in the core sales, communication, CRM, and marketing skills this position requires.





How We Operate



We give our team clear goals, tools, and the opportunity to take ownership. In return, we expect professionalism, accountability, and excellent execution.



Our operating principles are:



- Customer First: Every interaction should create value and build trust.

- Results Over Activity: We measure outcomes, not how busy you are.

- Own the Outcome: Take initiative, solve problems, and follow through.

- Focus on What Matters: Prioritize the work that generates the greatest impact.

- Raise the Standard: Deliver excellent work and continuously improve.

- Move Fast: Execute, measure, learn, and improve.

- Zero Silent Failures: Communicate problems early and bring a recovery plan.

- No Proof = Not Done: Use Asana to document commitments, deadlines, completed work, and results.

- Build Better Systems: Improve processes instead of repeatedly working around problems.



We don't believe great people need to be micromanaged. We believe they need clear expectations, the right tools, and the opportunity to perform.



How Success Is Measured



You'll have a written performance scorecard with clearly defined goals.



Success includes:



- Higher percentages of qualified inquiries converted into paying customers.

- More customers generated through follow-up and reactivation.

- More paying customers from referrals and local partnerships.

- Improved customer retention and repeat bookings.

- Better customer service and sales call quality.

- Accurate CRM management and consistent follow-through.

- Successful execution of marketing initiatives that generate measurable business results.



Your results—not simply your activity—will determine your performance.



Compensation: Exceptional Results Deserve Exceptional Rewards



We believe talented people who create meaningful business results should have the opportunity to earn more.



Monthly Compensation (USD)

- Guaranteed Base Salary: $1,000/month

- On-Target Earnings: $3,000/month total

- Exceptional Performance: Up to $4,000/month total



Performance bonuses are based on agreed-upon, measurable business results. Specific goals, bonus calculations, and eligibility will be established in a written performance scorecard. Bonus earnings are not guaranteed.



Produce more value. Earn more.





How to Apply  

Please submit:  

-Your current resume.  

-One example of something you personally accomplished in a previous position, including measurable results.  



We care more about demonstrated performance, initiative, and results than degrees or certifications.

title: Property Manager/Vendor Coordination
description:
Location: Remote 

Core Availability: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm Eastern Time (USA) 

Compensation: up to $2,000 per month 



SteelSafe Self Storage operates storage properties across the United States. Customers rent individual storage units and shipping containers from us to store their belongings, business inventory, equipment, and other items. 



Our properties are managed remotely. When a customer moves out, we need to quickly inspect, clean, repair, and prepare that storage unit so the next customer can rent it. 



We’re hiring a Vendor Coordination/Property Manager to own that process remotely. Your main goal is simple: keep our properties Rent-Ready and get units back on the market fast. 



What you get: 

A clear scoreboard and a role that matters. 

Direct access to leadership and fast decisions. 

A system-driven operation (we run on Asana). 

Performance bonus opportunity tied to ops execution. 

High trust and real autonomy. 

Real authority. You are not here to pass problems to someone else. You have the authority to solve them and improve the systems behind them. 

Freedom earned through results. We care about outcomes, not looking busy. Own the result, get the job done, then build systems so the job demands less of you tomorrow. 



What you’ll do: 

Manage the entire unit turnover process: after a customer moves out, make sure the unit is inspected, cleaned, repaired if needed, and ready for the next customer to rent. 

Manage local Boots-On-The-Ground (BOTG) contractors who physically inspect, clean, repair, and maintain our properties. 

Assign maintenance and repair jobs, follow up until they are completed, and verify the finished work using photos or videos. 

Keep sites customer-ready: gates, locks, cameras, lighting, cleanliness, and curb appeal meet SteelSafe standards. 

Handle property projects end‑to‑end (example: order a sign, coordinate install, confirm with proof). 



What you own (outcomes): 

Median Time‑to‑Rent‑Ready (TTRR) after move‑out. 

Rent‑Ready Unit % stays high and trending up. 

Work orders are dispatched quickly, completed quickly, and closed with proof. 

BOTG tasks are completed on time with proof, and contractor records and payments stay current. 

Publish a weekly scorecard that identifies misses, drives action, and holds owners accountable. 



The authority and tools you’ll have: 

You have the authority to improve the operation: turn workflows, proof standards, BOTG and vendor performance, inspection schedules, and the systems used to keep properties Rent-Ready. 

Asana as the operating system (tasks, checklists, proof). 



This role is a fit if you: 

Take initiative. Act fast. Identify problems, make sound decisions, and act within your authority without waiting for instructions. Clear your blockers fast. Move with relentless urgency.  

Own the outcome. Delegating work doesn't delegate responsibility. When contractors fail or projects stall, find another solution and see it through.  

Deliver results, not activity. We don't measure effort, calls, or hours worked. We measure problems solved and jobs completed.  

Demand excellence. Hold yourself, your team, and contractors to high standards. Done means done right, on time, and verified.  

Communicate early. Raise problems before they become missed deadlines. No surprises, excuses, or hidden problems.  

Fix the root cause. Don't just solve today's problem. Build simple systems that prevent it from happening again.



How to Apply

Please submit:

-Your current resume.

-One example of something you personally accomplished in a previous position, including measurable results.

title: Medical Billing and Credentialing Specialist
description:
About the role:



Avita Integrative Care and Avita Psychological Care are psychology group practices serving New Jersey and New York. We are hiring an experienced specialist with a proven record in U.S. insurance billing, claims resolution, accounts receivable, and clinician credentialing.



Mental health billing is strongly preferred. Psychological or neuropsychological testing and assessment billing is a major plus.

You will join our existing remote billing team and collaborate with our intake coordinator, clinicians, and practice leadership.



What you will do:

- Perform Verification of Benefits (VOB) using our existing online platforms and payer portals, and make direct calls to payers when phone verification or clarification is needed. Document eligibility, covered services, client cost sharing, authorization requirements, and relevant limitations.

- Review and submit accurate claims using EHR systems (TherapyNotes); Independently resolve rejections, denials, underpayments, and unpaid claims through payer calls, corrected claims, reconsiderations, and appeals.

- Investigate and challenge insurance recoupments and clawbacks: assess payer reasons, coordinate supporting records, develop case-specific dispute and appeal strategies, and track response deadlines. Identify root causes and implement preventive checks for eligibility, authorizations, coding, provider enrollment, and documentation in collaboration with clinicians and billing colleagues.

- Monitor aging reports, prioritize overdue accounts and filing deadlines, and maintain a documented next action and follow-up date for unresolved claims.

- Review EOBs and ERAs, investigate payment discrepancies, and help reconcile posted payments and client balances.

- Handle clinician and group credentialing, payer enrollment, CAQH maintenance, re-credentialing, and group affiliations. Track applications through confirmed participation and effective dates.

- Resolve client billing questions with patience and clear explanations of insurance payments, deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, and balances.

- Coordinate assigned accounts and handoffs with other virtual billing colleagues; maintain accurate shared records and flag issues needing escalation.

- Monitor official payer updates affecting New York and New Jersey billing, telehealth, authorizations, testing, and provider eligibility; communicate relevant changes to the team.

- Provide weekly updates on aging balances, resolved claims, credentialing progress, and outstanding issues.



Required experience and skills:

- At least three years of direct U.S. medical insurance billing experience, including benefits verification, plus hands-on clinician credentialing and payer enrollment experience.

- Demonstrated success resolving denied or aging claims and completing insurance panel enrollments.

- Proven experience disputing insurance recoupments or clawbacks, developing effective resolution strategies, and implementing measures to reduce future recoupment risk.

- Current working knowledge of New York and New Jersey payer processes and the ability to independently verify plan-specific requirements.

- Working knowledge of CPT and ICD-10 terminology, modifiers, authorizations, EOBs, ERAs, coordination of benefits, and filing and appeal deadlines.

- Excellent spoken and written English, confident payer phone communication, respectful client service, and reliable collaboration with a remote team.



Especially helpful experience:

- Mental health or behavioral health group-practice billing.

- Psychological or neuropsychological testing billing, including authorizations, time and unit requirements, and primary and add-on code relationships.

- TherapyNotes, CAQH, Availity, clearinghouses, and payer portals.

- Aetna, Cigna or Evernorth, Horizon BCBS, UnitedHealthcare or Optum, Oxford, or Carelon.



Schedule and secure workspace:

title: Mobile First Landing Page Designer | UI/UX & CRO Specialist
description:
We are a UK based digital services business looking for an exceptionally talented mobile-first landing page designer to join our growing team.



Our business, Win Your PIP, provides digital guidance and personalised writing support to help people navigate the UK Personal Independence Payment (PIP) application process.



We are developing multiple customer acquisition funnels using
, Google Ads and other digital marketing channels.



We already have a dedicated web developer and an established content and marketing strategy.



We are not looking for another developer. We are looking for someone who knows how to turn good content into beautifully designed, high-converting mobile landing pages.



Our current website/landing page:







Please review this page before applying.



What We're Looking For



Our current landing page has strong content, customer psychology and a clearly structured offer.



However, we believe the mobile design is holding back its potential.



The page currently feels too lengthy, with oversized headings, competing text, excessive card spacing and sections that don't flow naturally into one another.



We want someone who understands that great landing page design isn't simply about looking attractive. It's about guiding a customer towards taking action.



You should understand how customers behave when arriving from paid advertisements, how to build trust, how to reduce hesitation and how to present information in a way that feels effortless to navigate.



We're looking for a polished, modern, SaaS-inspired visual experience, tailored to our audience and service.



Your Responsibilities



1. Design conversion focused landing pages



Create engaging, mobile first landing pages built around specific audiences, advertising messages and customer needs.



Translate existing copy, research and marketing briefs into persuasive visual layouts.



Establish clear customer journeys from the opening headline through to the final call to action.



Design for purchases, enquiries, lead generation and other measurable conversion goals.



Ensure the landing page experience reflects the advertisement that brought the visitor there.



2. Own the mobile UI/UX design



Create exceptional typography, visual hierarchy and spacing.



Ensure headlines, supporting copy, imagery and buttons work together rather than compete for attention.



Reduce unnecessary scrolling, clutter and cognitive overload.



Make text-heavy information feel simple, professional and engaging.



Design responsive layouts that work particularly well on mobile devices.



Consider accessibility and usability for older and less technologically confident customers.



3. Apply conversion rate optimisation principles



Understand above-the-fold design, customer psychology, trust signals, offer presentation and CTA placement.



Identify friction points that may prevent users from progressing or purchasing.



Use clear visual storytelling, persuasive design and appropriate social proof.



Recommend layout changes informed by user behaviour and conversion data.



Produce design variations for A/B testing.



Work with our marketing team to continuously improve landing-page performance.



4. Build reusable Figma design systems



Create complete, fully editable Figma landing-page designs.



Develop reusable sections, layouts, components and templates.



Establish consistent typography styles, spacing, colours and responsive design rules.



Create a component library that can be adapted for multiple landing pages and advertising campaigns.



Use Figma Auto Layout, components and variants to support efficient future design work.



5. Prepare professional developer handoffs



Deliver organised Figma files containing editable text, headings, images, buttons and components.



Provide clear specifications for our existing developer.



Include desktop and mobile layouts where required.



Explain responsive behaviour and interactive elements.



Review the implemented design and identify any visual discrepancies.



You will not be responsible for coding, building or deploying websites. Our existing developer handles all implementation.



Essential Requirements



Proven experience specifically designing mobile-first landing pages.



Advanced Figma skills, including Auto Layout, components and design systems.



Strong understanding of CRO and direct-response marketing.



Excellent typography, visual hierarchy and composition.



Experience designing landing pages for
, Instagram or Google Ads traffic.



Ability to design lead-generation funnels, sales pages, product/service offer pages and checkout-focused journeys.



Ability to work from existing content and translate it into a cohesive, high-quality design.



Experience preparing developer-ready Figma files.



Strong communication skills and the ability to explain design decisions.



Portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile landing-page design, not just desktop websites.



Highly Desirable



Previous work on high-converting SaaS, DTC, digital-product or service-based landing pages.



Experience working alongside media buyers, marketers or conversion strategists.



Understanding of A/B testing, heatmaps and user behaviour analytics.



Ability to explain previous design improvements using conversion results.



Experience building reusable landing-page template libraries.



Familiarity with accessibility and designing for older audiences.



Recruitment Task



As part of your application, please take our existing landing page:







And show us how you would transform it into a beautifully designed, mobile-optimised, conversion-focused landing page in Figma. This doesnt need to be the final version, we just need to see you understand our request.



Our existing content and customer journey have already been developed.



Your responsibility is to reimagine the visual experience and demonstrate what you can do.



We are particularly concerned with:



Oversized headings and inconsistent typography.



Too much competing information on mobile.



Excessive scrolling and unnecessarily large cards.



Lack of visual flow between sections.



Generic layouts that feel assembled rather than professionally designed.



Making the page more engaging, trustworthy and easier to navigate towards purchase.



We want somebody who can bring independent creative thinking to these problems, not simply rearrange our existing boxes.



Please provide:



A proposed redesign of part or all of the current page in Figma.



A brief written explanation of the biggest design issues you identify.



An explanation of what you changed, why you made those decisions and how your redesign improves the existing experience.



Your approach to improving typography, content hierarchy, visual flow and CTA positioning.



An explanation of the purpose behind your design choices and how you believe they would help customers navigate the page and convert.



A design output you can realistically provide within the time available.



This is your opportunity to show us what you can do. We are interested in both the quality of the design and your ability to communicate your thinking clearly in writing.



If you have any other portfolio work, please feel free to send us information about other landing pages you have designed, particularly pages created to generate purchases or leads.



This does not need to be a completed landing-page design. We are looking for an initial concept that demonstrates your creative thinking and understanding of our requirements.



Shortlisted applicants will be d
 and contacted regarding the next stage.



Long-Term Opportunity



Our intention is to establish a reusable mobile conversion design system that can support multiple landing pages across our business.



Future projects include landing pages for different customer audiences, Google Ads campaigns,
 advertising funnels, condition-specific campaigns and our associated charity website.



Once the initial design system has been established, we want to create and test new landing-page variations efficiently.



This is an ongoing opportunity for the right person to take ownership of our landing-page visual design.



We value excellent work, reliable communication, strong creative thinking and continuous improvement.



This is a freelance role built around trust and responsibility. The relevant specification will be sent to you, and we expect you to complete the work in the manner discussed and to the agreed standard.



Payment will be made through Wise or alternative payment routes on a weekly basis for the first four weeks, and then on a monthly basis after that.



How to Apply



Please
 your application directly to:







 subject: Mobile CRO Designer – Your Name



Please include:



1. Your portfolio



Provide links to 2–3 mobile landing pages you have personally designed, preferably with editable Figma examples or mobile screenshots.



We are particularly interested in commercial landing pages designed to generate purchases or leads.



2. Your conversion design experience



Briefly explain how you approach conversion-focused mobile design.



If you have previous conversion results, A/B testing examples or measurable improvements, please share them.



3. Your proposed redesign of our current page



Please review:







Complete the recruitment task described above and send us your initial redesign concept, along with your written explanation of:



The biggest design issues you identify.



What you changed and why.



How you improved the mobile conversion experience.



Your approach to typography, content hierarchy, visual flow and CTA positioning.



The purpose behind your design decisions.



How you believe your proposed design would help customers navigate the page and encourage conversions.



If you have any other portfolio work, please feel free to send us information about other landing pages you have designed.



4. Your availability and rate



Please confirm your preferred monthly part-time rate, approximate weekly availability and the level of design output you could realistically provide.



We're particularly interested in how efficiently you can produce new landing-page variations once reusable Figma templates have been established.



What Success Looks Like



We're looking for someone who can take a content-heavy landing page and make it feel:



Simple. Modern. Trustworthy. Intuitive. Engaging. Conversion-focused.



Someone who understands that the best design guides the customer's attention rather than competing for it.



If you have a strong eye for exceptional mobile design and genuinely understand conversion psychology, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply by
ing 
 with your portfolio, experience and initial redesign ideas.

Perks:

-Ongoing mentorship and access to resources for skill development

title: Construction Sales & Estimating Coordinator
description:
# Construction Sales & Estimating Coordinator – U.S. Construction Company



**About Us**



Cornerstone Crushing is a U.S.-based company specializing in mobile concrete and asphalt crushing, aggregate production, and quarry operations. We provide mobile crushing services throughout the eastern United States and supply construction aggregates from our quarry locations. Our customers include demolition contractors, excavating companies, paving contractors, and other construction businesses..



We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented professional to assist with construction estimating, business development, and sales prospecting.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, researching projects, communicating with customers, and helping grow a business. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of responsibilities, work independently, and proactively identify opportunities.



## Key Responsibilities



**1. Construction Estimating & Proposal Preparation**



- Prepare estimates for mobile concrete and asphalt crushing projects using our established Excel pricing templates.

- Review project information, quantities, locations, specifications, and other requirements.

- Calculate project costs using established production rates, equipment costs, mobilization expenses, and other assumptions.

- Prepare professional proposals for management review and approval.

- Manage incoming bid opportunities assigned by management.

- Track bid deadlines, outstanding proposals, and follow-up activities.

- Identify missing information and coordinate with management as needed.



Training will be provided on our crushing operations, estimating methods, and proposal formats.



**2. Business Development & Lead Generation**



- Research upcoming construction, demolition, excavation, and infrastructure projects.

- Search construction bid boards, public project listings, and other online resources.

- Identify contractors and decision-makers who may need mobile crushing services.

- Develop and maintain a database of prospective customers and projects.

- Contact prospective customers through personalized
s and professional phone calls.

- Follow up on opportunities and help generate new business.



**3. Quarry Sales & Marketing**



- Research construction projects and contractors near our quarry locations.

- Identify potential buyers of crushed stone, gravel, recycled aggregate, and other construction materials.

- Contact contractors, estimators, project managers, and purchasing personnel.

- Introduce our products and services and identify potential sales opportunities.

- Assist with preparing material quotations using company-approved pricing.

- Follow up with prospective customers and coordinate qualified opportunities with management.

- Develop relationships with contractors who may become recurring customers.



**4. AI Tools & Process Improvement**



- Use AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve efficiency in research, lead generation, estimating support, and professional communications.

- Leverage AI to identify potential customers, organize project information, and streamline repetitive tasks.

- Independently identify opportunities to improve workflows and productivity.

- Verify AI-generated information for accuracy before using it in estimates, proposals, or customer communications.

- Protect confidential company and customer information when using AI tools.



## Qualifications



**Required:**



- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate naturally and professionally with U.S. contractors.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills and comfort working with numbers, formulas, and pricing spreadsheets.

- Experience in construction estimating, B2B sales, business development, or lead generation.

- Proficiency using AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve productivity, conduct research, and solve problems.

- Strong internet research skills and ability to identify potential construction projects and customers.

- Comfortable making outbound business calls and communicating directly with potential customers.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, dependable, and capable of working independently.

- Reliable internet connection and a professional remote working environment.



**Preferred:**



- Experience working with U.S. construction companies.

- Background in civil engineering, quantity surveying, or construction estimating.

- Experience with excavation, demolition, aggregates, heavy equipment, or construction materials.

- Familiarity with construction bid boards and contractor databases.

- Experience with Microsoft Office, Outlook, and CRM systems.



Prior experience in crushing or quarry operations is not required. Training will be provided.



## What We're Looking For



We are not looking for someone who simply follows instructions or performs basic data entry.



We want a proactive individual who enjoys finding opportunities, researching projects, communicating with customers, and completing detailed work accurately.



The ideal candidate is comfortable with both numbers and people. They should be able to prepare estimates carefully while also confidently reaching out to prospective customers.



We value initiative, problem-solving ability, attention to detail, and the ability to use technology and AI tools to work efficiently.



## Schedule & Compensation



- Initially approximately 30 hours per week, with the potential to increase to 40 hours.

- Some availability during U.S. Eastern business hours is required for customer calls and communication.

- Competitive hourly compensation based on experience and qualifications.

- Long-term opportunity with the potential for increased responsibilities.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume and a brief introduction.

2. A description of your experience working with U.S. construction companies, estimating, or B2B sales.

3. Your experience using Excel for calculations or estimating.

4. A short audio or video introduction (approximately 60–90 seconds) explaining your relevant experience and why you're interested in this position.

5. Your desired hourly rate and availability during U.S. Eastern business hours.



**Please also answer these two questions:**



**Question 1:** If you were asked to find potential customers for a quarry selling crushed stone and gravel in Ohio, as well as contractors who may need mobile concrete and asphalt crushing services throughout the eastern United States, how would you identify potential customers, find project opportunities, and begin contacting them?



**Question 2:** Describe how you currently use AI tools such as ChatGPT in your work. Please provide a specific example of how AI has helped you complete a task more efficiently or effectively.



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship and helping grow our business.

    •    Previous experience as a Video Editor, Social Media Manager, or Content Creator.

    •    Experience creating videos that achieved high organic reach or went viral.

    •    Understanding of social media analytics, including views, watch time, shares, saves, and engagement.

    •    Experience editing talking-head videos, interviews, podcasts, educational content, or promotional videos.

    •    Ability to suggest creative concepts, write hooks, and improve existing video ideas.

    •    Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.



What We're Looking For

We want someone who is creative, curious, and proactive. Someone who doesn't simply follow instructions but can also bring fresh ideas to the table.

Our ideal candidate:

    •    Understands what makes people stop scrolling.

    •    Can explain why a video performed well and how to apply those lessons to future content.

    •    Is comfortable experimenting with different hooks, formats, and editing styles.

    •    Takes ownership of their work and pays attention to the little details.

    •    Is organized, reliable, and open to constructive feedback.

    •    Can work independently while collaborating with a creative team.

    •    Focuses on creating effective content, not just making videos look good.



Show Us Your Viral Reels!

This is an important part of your application. Without this, we aren’t interested. 

We want to see what you've actually created and how your videos performed.



Please include:

    •    Links to at least 3–5 Reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts you personally created.

    •    Links to at least 2–3 of your best-performing videos, preferably those with high organic views.

    •    The view counts and engagement results for your strongest videos.

    •    Team players who collaborate well.

    •    Honest and transparent communication.

    •    Kindness and consideration toward others.

    •    Accountability and pride in delivering quality work.

    •    A positive attitude and someone who's fun to work with, even on Zoom!



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

    1    Your resume.

    2    A brief introduction about yourself and your video editing experience.

    3    Your portfolio with direct links to your best videos.

    4    Examples of high-performing or viral Reels, including view counts and engagement results.

    6    The editing tools and AI tools you use.



Please change the subject line of your application to: "Look No Further! Great videos here.”

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to a brief interview and a small editing test using footage provided by our team.

Please note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



We're excited to meet you if you’re ready to bring creativity, strong editing skills, and a results-driven mindset to our team!

description:
Social Media Strategist & Campaign Manager — Human Frequency

10 hours per week | Three-month engagement



We’re looking for someone who can turn our existing content, client stories and offers into clear social media campaigns that help generate qualified enquiries and bookings.

Human Frequency helps people understand their body and build their capacity through breathing, release and movement. We have an existing team handling video editing, graphics and other marketing tasks.

We need an experienced strategist to give that team clearer direction: which client moment to use, what hook to build, what outcome to communicate and what invitation should follow.



Your role

Audit our social media and identify priorities.

Review our content, analytics and approach across Instagram and
. Explain what has worked, what hasn’t, what the evidence supports and what we should test next.

Build campaigns with Coach Sako.

Help develop campaign angles, present our offers clearly and plan content that leads towards enquiries and bookings. This includes campaigns for clarity calls and workshops.

Turn raw footage into creative direction.

Review client testimonials, founder videos and training footage. Identify useful stories and moments, then create clear briefs covering the hook, message, footage, outcome and call to action.

Guide our existing team.

Give practical instructions our editors and designers can follow. Review the finished creatives and provide feedback so they communicate the intended message.

Research relevant market opportunities.

Study audience responses, competitors and content approaches on Instagram and
. Explain which ideas are relevant to Human Frequency and why they are worth testing.

Analyse results and improve the plan.

Review content performance alongside enquiries and bookings. Help us understand what contributed to results, where information is missing and what to change next.



Who we’re looking for

You can show examples of campaigns you helped plan and explain your personal contribution, the reasoning behind your decisions and the results you could verify.

You understand hooks, storytelling, offers, calls to action and the journey from content to enquiry. You can give specific creative direction and explain analytics in plain English.

You’re comfortable working within 10 hours per week, choosing priorities and coordinating with an existing team.

You’re also willing to understand Human Frequency’s audience, values and coaching approach. Recommendations should reflect our message and use client stories accurately.



What success looks like

Our team has clearer priorities and creative briefs. Our content connects to purposeful campaigns. We can see what is generating suitable enquiries and bookings, and use that information to improve.

This role focuses on strategy, auditing, campaign planning, creative direction and analysis. Our existing team handles video editing and graphic production.



Payment

Payment will be discussed directly with Coach Sako.



To apply

Please share one relevant campaign example, including:

The business goal and audience.



What you personally planned or directed.

The creative approach and offer.

The results and how they were measured.



Please also confirm your availability for 10 hours per week over three months.

title: Social Media Strategy & Growth Manager – Singapore Real Estate
description:
Social Media Strategy & Growth Manager – Singapore Real Estate



FULL-TIME | REMOTE | SENIOR / EXPERIENCED CANDIDATES ONLY



About Us



We are a Singapore-based real estate business looking for an experienced, strategic, and results-driven Social Media Strategy & Growth Manager to take full ownership of our social media direction, branding, marketing strategy, and lead generation.



This is a management and advisory-level position, not a basic content posting or video editing role.



We are looking for someone who can advise a Singapore Property Agent on what to do, what content to create, how to grow brand exposure, and how to convert social media attention into quality property buyer and seller enquiries.



You must be able to develop strategies, lead execution, analyse results, and proactively recommend improvements without waiting for daily instructions.



Your Main Mission



To build and manage an effective social media marketing system that:



1. Establishes a strong and recognisable Singapore Property Agent personal brand.

2. Increases exposure to the right Singapore audience.

3. Generates consistent, quality buyer and seller enquiries.

4. Improves content performance, audience engagement, and conversion.

5. Develops a long-term, sustainable social media growth strategy.



Key Responsibilities



1. Marketing Strategy & Advisory



This is the most important part of your role.



- Act as the main social media strategist and marketing advisor to the business owner.

- Assess our current social media performance and identify areas for improvement.

- Develop clear monthly and quarterly marketing strategies.

- Advise what types of content we should produce, why they will work, and what results we should aim to achieve.

- Recommend the best approaches for growing brand awareness and generating property leads.

- Research successful Singapore property agents, competitor strategies, and market opportunities.

- Identify new marketing channels, content formats, and growth opportunities.

- Proactively propose solutions when performance is below expectations.

- Provide strategic recommendations based on data, market research, and audience behaviour.



2. Overall Social Media Management



Take ownership of our social media operations across:



- TikTok

- Instagram

-

- YouTube Shorts



Responsibilities include:



- Plan and manage weekly and monthly content calendars.

- Develop an appropriate posting frequency and distribution strategy for each platform.

- Oversee content quality, consistency, and branding.

- Coordinate with video editors, designers, and other marketing support staff.

- Provide clear instructions and creative direction to the editing team.

- Review completed content and recommend improvements.

- Manage content scheduling and publishing workflows.

- Ensure marketing activities are completed on time.



You are responsible for managing the entire social media process, not necessarily doing all the editing yourself.



3. Content Strategy & Creative Direction



- Develop engaging content ideas specifically for Singapore property buyers and sellers.

- Plan content themes around HDB resale, private properties, property investment, market education, and personal branding.

- Propose attention-grabbing hooks, video concepts, captions, and calls to action.

- Advise the Property Agent on what videos to record and how to present them effectively.

- Prepare video briefs, scripts, talking points, and filming plans.

- Identify trending topics and adapt relevant formats to Singapore real estate.

- Develop a balance of educational, entertaining, branding, and lead generation content.

- Repurpose existing property videos to maximise content value.



4. Lead Generation & Marketing Funnel



- Develop strategies to attract homeowners considering selling their properties.

- Create campaigns to generate genuine buyer and seller leads.

- Improve conversions from content views to profile visits, WhatsApp enquiries, and appointments.

- Recommend improvements to social media profiles, landing pages, and lead capture processes.

- Work with our PA / inbound sales team to ensure enquiries are properly tracked.

- Measure which content and campaigns generate the most qualified leads.

- Propose paid advertising strategies where appropriate.

- Manage or coordinate approved Meta advertising campaigns if experienced.



Our priority is not just followers or viral videos. We want measurable business opportunities.



5. Performance Analysis & Growth Optimisation



- Monitor account growth, reach, video retention, engagement, and conversions.

- Analyse successful and underperforming content.

- Explain what is working, what is not, and why.

- Recommend specific changes to improve results.

- Conduct regular content testing and optimise future strategies.

- Track qualified buyer and seller enquiries generated through social media.

- Present weekly performance reports and monthly strategy reviews.

- Develop clear action plans to improve future performance.



Every report should answer:



1. What worked?

2. What did not work?

3. Why?

4. What should we change?

5. What should we do next?



6. Team Coordination & Accountability



- Lead and coordinate our social media content workflow.

- Work closely with video editors, designers, and administrative support.

- Establish deadlines, priorities, and content production schedules.

- Monitor deliverables and ensure timely completion.

- Resolve workflow issues and recommend process improvements.

- Take ownership of agreed marketing targets and execution quality.

- Escalate matters requiring the business owner's approval.



Mandatory Requirements



- Minimum 3 years of proven experience in social media management, digital marketing, or content strategy.

- Previous experience developing and managing successful social media growth strategies.

- Strong understanding of personal branding and lead generation.

- Experience managing content creators, video editors, or marketing workflows.

- Proven ability to analyse performance and translate insights into actionable plans.

- Strong knowledge of TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube marketing.

- Able to demonstrate actual account growth, successful campaigns, and business results.

- Excellent English communication and presentation skills.

- Strong leadership, creative thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

- Proactive, independent, highly organised, and results-oriented.

- Able to work quickly and effectively in a fast-paced environment.

- Comfortable taking responsibility for planning, execution, and performance reviews.



Highly Preferred:



- Experience managing social media for Singapore real estate agents.

- Understanding of Singapore HDB, condominium, and property buyer/seller audiences.

- Experience with Meta Ads and performance marketing.

- Experience growing a professional personal brand.



This position is NOT suitable for beginners, basic social media posters, or candidates who require constant supervision.



What We Expect From You



You should be someone who:



- Thinks like a marketing manager, not just a content creator.

- Comes to meetings with ideas and recommendations.

- Understands how branding, marketing, and lead generation work together.

- Takes initiative to identify problems and propose solutions.

- Can challenge existing strategies with constructive, data-backed suggestions.

- Understands the importance of speed, quality, and results.

- Takes ownership of the overall social media direction.



We do not want to provide every idea or instruction ourselves.



We want you to be the expert who advises us on how to grow.



Expected Deliverables



Weekly:



- Updated content and publishing plan.

- Creative briefs and filming recommendations.

- Coordination with editors and marketing support.

- Social media performance updates.

- Practical recommendations for improvement.



Monthly:



- Comprehensive social media growth report.

- Analysis of brand reach, engagement, and lead generation.

- Competitor and market opportunity review.

- Next month's content strategy and campaign plan.

- Clear priorities, improvement actions, and recommended experiments.



Working Arrangements



- Full-time, 40 hours per week.

- 100% remote, Philippines-based.

- Working hours aligned with Singapore time (GMT+8).

- Work directly with the Singapore Property Agent and support team.

- Long-term position with growth opportunities.



Salary



Depending on relevant experience, strategic capabilities, and proven performance.



Higher compensation may be considered for exceptional candidates with a strong track record.



Performance-based incentives may be offered.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your updated CV.

2. Number of years in social media management and marketing strategy.

3. Links to at least two social media accounts you have managed.

4. Examples of marketing strategies you developed and the results achieved.

5. Evidence of brand growth or lead generation performance.

6. Your experience managing creative teams and content workflows.

7. Your expected monthly salary.



Mandatory Screening Questions



Question 1 – Strategic Thinking



If you were appointed to manage the entire social media presence of a Singapore Property Agent, what would be your first 30-day action plan?



Question 2 – Lead Generation



What strategies would you implement to attract Singapore homeowners interested in selling their HDB flats or condominiums?



Question 3 – Performance Improvement



If we consistently post videos but our enquiries and engagement remain low, how would you identify the problems and improve results?



Question 4 – Past Results



Share an example of a brand or account you managed. Explain the strategy you developed, what you changed, and the measurable improvement achieved.



IMPORTANT



We are hiring a SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY & GROWTH MANAGER — NOT A CONTENT UPLOADER.



We need someone who can LEAD, ADVISE, PLAN, EXECUTE, ANALYSE, and DRIVE GROWTH.



Our goal is to build a strong Singapore Property Agent brand that generates genuine business opportunities through effective social media marketing.

title: Architectural Stone CAD Drafter & Estimator
description:
Position: Architectural Stone CAD Drafter & Estimator



We are seeking an experienced CAD drafter and estimator who can transform architectural plans, designer renderings, elevations, and field measurements into accurate, fabrication-ready shop drawings for natural stone projects.



The ideal candidate understands natural stone slabs, wall cladding, flooring, countertops, large-format panels, fireplaces, exterior façades, and custom architectural stonework.



Primary Responsibilities



* Review architectural plans, designer renderings, specifications, and field measurements.

* Create detailed 2D and 3D shop drawings for client approval and fabrication.

* Develop elevations, sections, details, dimensions, joint locations, anchoring details, and installation layouts.

* Prepare slab-layout drawings showing how each piece will be cut from full slabs.

* Determine the number of slabs required for each project.

* Create accurate material takeoffs, cut lists, piece schedules, and square-foot quantities.

* Optimize slab usage to reduce waste while maintaining proper color and vein continuity.

* Lay out book-matched, vein-matched, and sequentially installed stone when required.

* Identify missing dimensions, conflicts, and constructability issues before fabrication.

* Coordinate drawing revisions with designers, architects, estimators, fabricators, and installers.

* Maintain organized drawing files, revision records, and project documentation.

* Assist the estimating department with labor, material, waste, and fabrication requirements.



Required Experience



* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD.

* Experience with SketchUp, Revit, Rhino, SolidWorks, or another 3D modeling platform.

* Previous drafting or estimating experience in natural stone, tile, countertops, architectural cladding, millwork, metal fabrication, glazing, or a similar fabrication industry.

* Ability to read architectural and structural plans.

* Strong understanding of dimensions, tolerances, joints, substrates, installation conditions, and fabrication limitations.

* Ability to calculate square footage, linear footage, piece quantities, slab requirements, and waste factors.

* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently.



Preferred Qualifications



* Direct experience creating natural-stone shop drawings and slab-cutting layouts.

* Experience with Slabsmith, Moraware, AlphaCAM, EasySTONE, or similar stone-industry software.

* Knowledge of marble, granite, quartzite, limestone, travertine, and thin natural stone veneer.

* Understanding of vein direction, slab sequencing, book matching, dry layouts, and material variation.

* Experience creating CNC-ready information is a plus.

* Familiarity with exterior cladding, mechanical fastening, adhered veneer, and large-format stone installation is highly desirable.



Required Work Samples



Applicants must provide examples of:



* AutoCAD shop drawings

* Architectural elevations and details

* Slab layouts or cutting diagrams

* Material takeoffs or cut lists

* Relevant 3D models or renderings



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who combines drafting ability with practical fabrication and estimating knowledge. This person should understand not only how to draw the project, but also how the stone will be selected, cut, matched, fabricated, delivered, and installed.

title: Short-Term Rental Specialist | Executive Assistant
description:
Endless Real Estate



About Us



Endless Real Estate is a growing real estate company with three business lines: Real Estate Sales (where your Executive Assistant work sits), Endless Stays (our own premium short-term rentals across NJ, TN, FL & VA), and Endless Asset Management (short-term rental management and co-hosting for other property owners). We're growing fast with an ambitious 10-year vision — this is a career opportunity, not just a job.



Our Core Values: World-Class Hospitality to Every Guest and Owner • Fix Once, Fix Forever • Own the Outcome • Systems Create Scale • Bring Excitement, Passion, and Integrity Every Day



Please read this posting carefully. Due to applicant volume, applicants who do not follow the instructions in this posting explicitly will not be considered.



The Role



We're hiring one fully remote team member to run our short-term rental operations day to day. This role will ultimately act as Executive Assistant to the Owner — responsible for all admin and ops work across our real estate business — with a clear path into leadership as we scale.



Schedule: Thursday–Monday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern, with a 1-hour unpaid lunch (Tuesdays and Wednesdays off).



Virtual office: You'll work camera-on in our virtual office during your shift — it's how our remote team stays connected. This one is (politely) non-negotiable.



Short-Term Rental Operations:





Own guest communication end-to-end, from inquiry through post-stay

Manage reservations across Airbnb, VRBO, 
, and direct

Coordinate cleaners, maintenance, and service providers

Monitor property conditions and uphold quality standards

Handle troubleshooting and service recovery

Execute company systems and keep documentation sharp





Executive Assistant & Admin:





Own admin and operations support for the Owner across all three business lines

Accounts payable and basic monthly prep for our bookkeepers

Admin support for social media and marketing

Qualifying calls with potential co-host clients





AI & Automation:





Learn and use AI tools — Claude and ChatGPT are part of the daily job here, and you'll be responsible for getting great at them

Property stack: Hospitable/OwnerRez (PMS), Breezeway, Quo, HostBuddy, StayFi, RankBreeze, Go High Level. Who You Are

An owner — you drive outcomes and solve problems without being chased

Hard requirement: Fluent English at a 9/10 level — written and verbal — with college-level comprehension (non-negotiable — please don't apply otherwise).



Huge plus: Notion, OwnerRez, or Hospitable experience.



What Makes This Different

You'll work directly with the CEO and get hands-on mentorship and training from day one. Your work directly drives guest satisfaction, property performance, and company growth.



Compensation





Competitive salary based on experience

Performance bonuses tied to property metrics

Fully remote

Clear advancement path with increased compensation





How to Apply



Submit:





Your resume

A 2–3 minute video introducing yourself, including a time you went above and beyond for a customer

Any questions you have about the position — including your salary requirements and whether they are negotiable





Important: To demonstrate your attention to detail, include the word "Jersey" in the subject line.



Reminder — due to applicant volume, applications that do not follow these instructions explicitly will not be considered.



If You're Selected to Interview



Due to applicant volume, candidates selected to interview will be required to watch a 25-minute video from our CEO and record answers to 6–7 questions and scenarios before a live interview.



This opportunity will be incredible for someone who is looking to grow, wants direct mentorship and training from the CEO, and really wants to be excited to come to work every day. We move fast for the right candidates — if that's you, apply now.

• Familiarity with marketing automation tools

What We Offer

• Career growth opportunities within a fast-growing agency

• Collaborative and innovative work environment

• Opportunity to work with diverse brands and industries

title: Senior Estimator – Heavy Steel Fabrication & Quality Support
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Hours: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Working Hours: Australian Business Hours

Experience: Heavy Steel Fabrication Estimating Experience – Trusses, Chutes, Process Piping, Frames and Structural Steel and associated QA/QC processes – minimum 2 years Australian experience.



About the Opportunity



We are seeking an experienced Senior Estimator – Heavy Steel Fabrication & Quality Support to join an established Australian steel fabrication and engineering business, providing dedicated support to the existing Senior Estimator and Project Management team.



This is a hybrid role, with approximately 70% focused on Estimator Support and 30% on Quality Support.



The primary focus is assisting the existing Senior Estimator with estimates, material take-offs, cutting lists, supplier pricing, tender documentation, and other estimating requirements for complex steel fabrication projects.



Experience with heavy steel fabrication is essential. We are looking for someone who understands the practical requirements, complexity, and quality standards involved in fabrication work such as structural steel, chutes, frames, trusses, and process piping. Experience supporting projects in heavy industry, mining, oil and gas, or similar environments is valuable, but direct employment by a mining or oil and gas company is not required.



The role also provides quality support across projects, including QA documentation, NDT requests, MDRs, weld maps, material traceability, and maintaining welding and quality registers.



The ideal candidate is a hands-on steel fabrication estimator with a strong understanding of fabrication processes and associated QA/QC documentation. They should be able to interpret drawings, prepare accurate estimates, and recognise the relevant quality requirements with minimal training.



This is not a standalone Senior Estimator position. The successful candidate will work as a hands-on support resource, stepping in to assist with estimating and quality requirements as needed while working closely with the existing team.



Key Responsibilities

1. Heavy Steel Fabrication & Technical Support

- Read and interpret engineering, structural, mechanical, and fabrication drawings.

- Estimate fabrication work involving structural steel, chutes, frames, trusses, process piping, and similar heavy steel fabrication.

- Understand fabrication methods, material specifications, welding requirements, and associated labour and machinery requirements.

- Assess the scope and complexity of fabrication work to support accurate estimating and pricing.

- Review job packs, drawings, and specifications to identify materials, fabrication requirements, and quality considerations.

- Identify discrepancies, missing information, and potential technical or fabrication issues before estimates are submitted.

- Understand how fabrication methods and project specifications affect costs, production requirements, and quality documentation.

- Liaise with the estimating, operations, project management, and quality teams to clarify technical requirements.



2. Estimator Support – Primary Focus

- Support the existing Senior Estimator with day-to-day estimating activities.

- Review client RFQs, engineering drawings, specifications, and project documentation.

- Interpret technical requirements and identify information requiring clarification.

- Prepare detailed Material Take-Offs (MTOs).

- Calculate material quantities and prepare cutting lists and other fabrication-related documentation.

- Assess material, machinery, labour, fabrication, and other project requirements.

- Assist with detailed estimates, cost calculations, and pricing for heavy steel fabrication work.

- Obtain and compare supplier pricing for materials and fabrication requirements.

- Liaise with suppliers to obtain current and accurate material costs.

- Assist with preparing quotations, proposals, and tender submissions.

- Review estimates for accuracy, scope, quantities, and pricing before submission.

- Assist with quote revisions, variations, and changes to project requirements.

- Support the Senior Estimator with tender deadlines and estimating workload.

- Provide estimating coverage when required.



3. Quality & Documentation Support – Approximately 30%

- Support the Quality function across active projects as required.

- Review job packs, drawings, specifications, and fabrication requirements to identify applicable QA/QC documentation.

- Prepare Weld Maps by identifying appropriate weld procedures and marking welds on drawings and weld traceability documentation.

- Prepare QA Packs for client submission and approval.

- Compile proposed weld procedures, welder qualifications, and supporting reports for project documentation.

- Prepare NDT requests and coordinate associated documentation.

- Prepare Welder Qualification Requests where required.

- Follow up with suppliers for material certificates and surface treatment reports.

- Prepare Manufacturer's Data Reports (MDRs).

- Track outstanding MDRs for completed projects and ensure they are submitted on time.

- Maintain accurate records of welder qualifications and welding documentation.

- Maintain the Welder Qualification Register, including weld reports and upcoming requalification requirements.

- Maintain the Weld Procedure Register and update it when new procedures are received.

- Assist with material traceability, delivery dockets, and related project documentation.

- Help ensure quality documentation aligns with project specifications, fabrication requirements, and client requirements.



4. Project & Team Support

- Work closely with the Senior Estimator, Project Managers, Operations, and Quality personnel.

- Provide estimating and quality support across multiple projects as priorities change.

- Participate in online meetings, drawing reviews, and project discussions.

- Proactively communicate progress, outstanding information, pricing issues, quality requirements, and potential risks.

- Raise issues early and seek clarification rather than allowing problems to delay estimates or project documentation.

- Assist Project Managers with project documentation, variations, and technical information where required.

- Help ensure a smooth handover from estimating through to project delivery.

- Provide support across estimating and quality functions when required.



Essential Requirements

- Minimum 2 years of Australian steel fabrication or engineering estimating experience.

- Demonstrated hands-on estimating experience involving heavy steel fabrication, including structural steel, chutes, frames, trusses, process piping, or comparable fabrication work.

- Strong understanding of steel fabrication estimating, including materials, labour, machinery, welding, and fabrication requirements.

- Demonstrated experience preparing MTOs, estimates, quotations, or tender submissions.

- Ability to read and interpret engineering, structural, mechanical, and fabrication drawings.

- Sound understanding of heavy fabrication processes and the practical requirements of complex fabrication projects.

- Working knowledge of associated QA/QC processes, quality requirements, material traceability, and fabrication documentation.

- Experience with quality documentation, quality control, or quality assurance processes.

- Ability to create or interpret Weld Maps and weld traceability documentation.

- Familiarity with NDT requests, QA Packs, MDRs, welder qualifications, and welding registers.

- Understanding of how project specifications and fabrication requirements affect quality documentation.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience with estimating or digital take-off software.

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organisational and time-management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

- Proactive approach to communication, problem-solving, and teamwork.

- Comfortable working remotely and collaborating daily with an Australian team.



Highly Desirable

- Experience estimating heavy fabrication projects for industrial, mining, oil and gas, resources, or similar sectors.

- Extensive Australian steel fabrication experience across structural steel, chutes, frames, trusses, process piping, or - comparable work.

- Experience across both estimating and quality control/quality assurance functions.

- Experience preparing QA Packs and MDRs for Australian projects.

- Experience with NDT coordination, welding documentation, and material traceability.

- Experience maintaining welder qualification and weld procedure registers.

- Understanding of carbon steel welding, with exposure to stainless steel, duplex steel, wear plate, or other specialised steels.

- Previous experience supporting Project Managers or Operations teams.

- Engineering degree, steel trade qualification, or relevant technical qualification.

- Experience with Bluebeam, CostX, Cubit, PlanSwift, or similar estimating and take-off software.



What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will become a reliable second layer of support for the existing estimating and project team.



Success means:

- Producing accurate and timely estimates for complex heavy steel fabrication work.

- Understanding fabrication scope, drawings, material requirements, and quality considerations with minimal training.

- Keeping MTOs, cutting lists, supplier pricing, and tender documentation organised and up to date.

- Helping the Senior Estimator manage estimating workload and deadlines.

- Providing dependable quality support when required.

- Ensuring QA Packs, MDRs, NDT requests, Weld Maps, and registers are completed accurately and on time.

- Identifying technical, estimating, and quality issues early and communicating proactively.

- Moving comfortably between estimating, project coordination, and quality documentation as business priorities require.



The Opportunity

- Full-time remote position based in the Philippines.

- Work Australian business hours.

- Join an established Australian steel fabrication and engineering team.

- Work directly alongside an experienced Senior Estimator and Project Managers.

- Approximately 70% Estimator Support / 30% Quality Support.

- Work on technically challenging steel fabrication projects.

- Opportunity to develop across estimating, project coordination, and quality functions.

- Long-term opportunity within a collaborative and technically focused team.

title: Creator Partnerships Assistant (UGC / Influencer Outreach)
description:
Hours: between 8AM-4PM Monday-Friday PHT 



About us

Sap Skin is an Australianbased body care brand. We make persimmon-based body wash and soap for adults who want to feel and smell fresh as they get older. We sell worldwide and work with real creators who make video ads for us on Meta.



What you’ll do



Use our 30 daily invites on TRYBE (a creator platform) to reach creators who fit our audience

Review creator applications against clear criteria and approve or decline them

Reply to creator messages in the TRYBE inbox within 24 hours, using our templates

Collect shipping details and track free product samples

Check delivered videos against a simple checklist before we approve them

Keep our creator tracker up to date and send a short weekly report



You’ll get a full step-by-step SOP, message templates and training. You don’t need to come up with the process yourself. We need you to follow it carefully and use good judgement.



You’ll be a great fit if you:



Write natural, friendly, fluent English (most creators are in the US, UK and Australia)

Are detail-oriented and consistent, and the kind of person who never leaves a message unanswered

Can tell a natural on-camera creator from a polished one

Are comfortable with Google Sheets and Slack

Have experience with influencer outreach, UGC, TikTok or Instagram 

Ability to use ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude to aid work



What we offer



Long-term, stable work with a growing brand

Clear SOPs and direct access to the owner

More hours and responsibility as the program grows



How to apply

Start your application with the word PERSIMMON so we know you read the whole listing. Then include:



A short intro about yourself and any outreach or social media experience

Your answers to the 3 questions below

Your availability in AEST



Applications without the word PERSIMMON won’t be considered.



Application questions



- Write a message under 250 characters inviting a 55-year-old creator to make a video ad for a body wash that helps people feel fresh as they age.

- A creator messages: “Can I say this product cures body odour?” How would you reply?

- A creator applies with 15 posts in the last 30 days and a 95% approval rate. Our minimum is 20 posts and 80% approval. Do you approve them? Why or why not?
